jobs.description:
Req198143

Position Purpose

The Project Manager is responsible for a combination of planning and execution of activities related to delivery of projects and/or financial/budgeting activity for their teams. When executing on project delivery, Project Managers are responsible for the success of one or more projects within a given timeline and budget, creation and maintenance of status reports, proactively managing issues and risks, and can work with 3rd party partners. When performing financial/budgeting activities they monitor and adjust to given budgets, track labor, capital spend, and support variance root cause analysis.

Key Responsibilities

75% - Delivery & Execution - Establishes and executes effective communication with Project Stakeholders; Partners with stakeholders to lead the project planning effort, including the formulation of the project scope, definition of the project deliverables and the required delivery dates, creation of a logical work breakdown structure, and definition of major project milestones; Understands organizational/initiative goals and success criteria to apply to project work. Ability and understanding of project plans and development, risk identification & mitigation. Applies lessons learned to inform future initiatives; Creates, monitors, tracks, and adjusts project plans based on critical milestones for a project of group of initiatives; Assists in development, then executes change management process and activities within Technology organization; Works with stakeholders to determine and align dependencies, then proactively risk and issues via identification and mitigation plans.
25% - Resource & Financial Management - Executes fiscal management and reporting for operational, product/business, technology, and vendor stakeholders; includes gross labor, capital spend, and non-labor forecasting for tracking, reporting, and variance analysis.

Direct Manager/Direct Reports

Position Reports to Senior Director, Pro Paint.
Position has 0 direct reports.

Travel Requirements

Typically requires overnight travel 5% to 20% of the time.

Physical Requirements

Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions, there may be a need to move or lift light articles.

Working Conditions

Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable.

Minimum Qualifications

Must be eighteen years of age or older.
Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.
Proficient knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite.
Proficient knowledge of Tableau.
Demonstrated ability to collaborate and work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Ability to draw accurate conclusions from financial documentation.
Demonstrated project management skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Experience with the planning and execution of projects and risk mitigation strategies.
Experience with project management execution in a modern software environment; experience managing technical projects.
Proficient knowledge of GBQ.
Experience in Agile, Waterfall or other project delivery methodologies.

Preferred Qualifications

Project/program management experience leading multiple technology, AI, automation, or emerging-technology initiatives simultaneously.
Proven ability to manage roadmaps, milestones, timelines, risks, dependencies, and deliverables across complex projects.
Strong cross-functional leadership, partnering with engineering, AI/ML, ServiceNow, cybersecurity, telephony, operations, and business teams.
Ability to translate between technical and business teams, clarify priorities, and drive execution when requirements evolve.
Strong stakeholder communication and executive-level reporting, including project status, risks, decisions, and escalations.
Experience driving technology adoption and organizational change from planning through implementation.
Familiarity with AI/ML, Microsoft Copilot/Copilot Studio, ServiceNow, conversational AI, contact-center technology, or similar automation platforms.
Experience in contact-center, IT support, or Technology Support Center environments, with an understanding of operational outcomes such as productivity, first-contact resolution, and cost per ticket.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager – Utility-Scale Solar
jobs.description:
Lead the Construction of Large-Scale Solar Energy Projects

Are you an experienced Construction Project Manager
with a proven track record of delivering large-scale utility-scale solar projects?

Expert Executive Recruiters (EER Global) is seeking a talented Construction Project Manager – Utility-Scale Solar
to lead and oversee major solar construction projects throughout the project lifecycle, from permitting and pre-construction through construction, commissioning and final handover to the Operations & Maintenance (O&M) team.

This opportunity is suited to a hands-on construction professional with direct experience managing utility-scale solar projects of 50 MW DC or larger per individual project
.

The successful candidate will take ownership of project execution, coordinating contractors, subcontractors, vendors, consultants and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently, on schedule and within approved budgets.

We are looking for someone who understands the complexities of utility-scale solar construction and can effectively manage project controls, commercial activities, construction progress, technical coordination and overall project performance.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Construction Execution

Lead and manage utility-scale solar construction projects from permitting and pre-construction through construction, commissioning and final handover.
Oversee day-to-day construction activities, ensuring compliance with project specifications, contractual requirements, quality standards and safety expectations.
Drive project execution to meet established budgets, schedules, milestones and delivery objectives.
Coordinate contractors, subcontractors, vendors, consultants and internal teams throughout the project lifecycle.

Budget, Schedule & Commercial Management

Develop, monitor and manage project budgets, cost forecasts, construction schedules and critical path milestones.
Oversee contractor agreements, subcontractor contracts, procurement activities and change orders.
Monitor project costs, commitments, cash flow and schedule performance, identifying potential issues and implementing corrective actions.
Manage RFIs, submittals, construction documentation and contractual matters.

Technical & Stakeholder Coordination

Coordinate engineering, procurement and construction activities to support successful project delivery.
Review construction drawings, specifications and technical documentation to identify and resolve design conflicts and field issues.
Coordinate with utilities, inspectors, permitting authorities, consultants and other external stakeholders.
Identify, assess and manage project risks, resolving construction challenges and maintaining effective stakeholder communication.

Commissioning & Project Closeout

Oversee commissioning activities, testing, punch lists and outstanding construction work.
Ensure completion of project documentation, as-built drawings, warranties and closeout requirements.
Coordinate final training and project handover to the Operations & Maintenance (O&M) team.

Team Leadership

Provide direction and oversight to project team members and contractors.
Establish clear project priorities, responsibilities and performance expectations.
Supervise direct reports and conduct performance reviews, where applicable.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Minimum one utility-scale solar construction project of 50 MW DC or larger successfully managed.

Direct, hands-on experience in the solar energy industry is mandatory.

Demonstrated experience managing large-scale construction projects from pre-construction through commissioning and final handover.
Strong understanding of utility-scale solar construction processes, EPC delivery models and construction management practices.
Proven experience managing project budgets, schedules, cost controls, contracts, procurement and subcontractor performance.
Experience coordinating multiple contractors, vendors, consultants, utilities and other project stakeholders.
Ability to interpret construction drawings, engineering specifications and technical documentation.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project scheduling tools such as Microsoft Project or Primavera P6.
Strong leadership, communication, negotiation, organizational and problem-solving skills.
Ability to manage competing priorities, identify project risks and drive successful project outcomes.
Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Project Management or a related discipline preferred. Equivalent relevant professional experience will also be considered.

Work Location & Travel

Location:
Indiana, United States | Remote
Travel:
Up to 25% – Virginia and Mid-Atlantic project locations

Candidates must be comfortable travelling to construction sites and coordinating with project teams and external stakeholders as required.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Total Rewards
jobs.description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

The Total Rewards Strategy & Enablement (TR S&E) team translates people strategy into business impact, building the infrastructure, programs, and systems that make Total Rewards work at scale. We're a small, high-leverage team that bridges strategy and execution, partnering with People leadership and cross-functional teams across Finance, Legal, and the business to turn ambiguous problems into durable programs.

What you’ll do

Stripe's Total Rewards programs span compensation, benefits, equity, internal mobility/immigration, and mergers and acquisitions (M&A), each with cross-functional dependencies, regulatory stakes, and direct impact on the Stripes they affect. Delivering these programs well takes a Project Manager who develops real subject matter depth, engages with pillar leads as a strategic partner, and brings structure to decisions that aren't always clear-cut.

We're hiring a Project Manager to own high-priority Total Rewards projects and programs end to end. You'll work closely with our Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Talent Mobility, and M&A pillars, building expertise in how these programs work and what it takes to land them well. Some programs have established playbooks you'll sharpen; others are less defined and will need you to help shape the approach before you execute it. Across all of them, you'll identify dependencies early, proactively surface and mitigate risks, and keep complex, multi-stakeholder work moving toward clear outcomes. This is a high-leverage individual contributor role for someone who brings both rigor and judgment to every project they own.

Responsibilities

Own end-to-end project management for high-profile cyclical and transformational Total Rewards projects, from intake and scoping through go-live and handoff to program owners
Advise and embed with project teams across the Total Rewards and People portfolio, raising the quality bar and building PM capability across the extended team, not just doing the work yourself
Build subject matter expertise across Benefits, Compensation, Equity, Talent Mobility, and M&A — becoming a reliable strategic thought partner to pillar teams on program decisions, not just a tracker of status
Build, automate, and continuously improve the infrastructure that makes program management repeatable and scalable: intake frameworks, project plan templates, SOPs, playbooks, and handoff checklists for common program types
Leverage AI tools in your daily work and the team's workflows, using them to accelerate synthesis, drafting, stakeholder communications, and documentation, and actively identifying new opportunities to work faster and better
Drive cross-functional alignment across People and key partner functions (Legal, Finance, Corporate Technology, and others), creating shared visibility into priorities, dependencies, and blockers
Tackle complex, ambiguous program questions with rigor and independence, owning work from problem definition through final recommendation — including defining the approach, monitoring progress, identifying risks early, and putting mitigation in place before issues land
Surface patterns and gaps across the program portfolio, translating observations into structured analysis and recommendations for People leadership

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements

7+ years of People project, program, or operations management experience, including at least 3 years driving multi-stakeholder, cross-functional programs end to end, ideally at a scaling or global company
A track record of building from scratch: you've created processes, playbooks, or program infrastructure where none existed before, not just improved what was already in place
Excellent written communication: you can produce an executive update, a stakeholder decision memo, and a practitioner playbook with equal fluency
Strong stakeholder management across senior cross-functional partners: you drive results with a balance of urgency and thoughtfulness, and know when to push, when to align, and when to escalate
AI expertise: you default to AI tools for synthesis, drafting, analysis, and communications, and you proactively design workflows that help the team move faster and operate at scale.
Analytical fluency: you can work with data to build a credible narrative, identify patterns across a program portfolio, and make recommendations grounded in evidence
A users-first mindset: you obsess over the Stripe employee experience and the operator experience, not just the project/program artifacts

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with change management frameworks (such as Prosci ADKAR) and judgment about when to apply structured change management vs. lighter-touch approaches
Experience building and deploying enablement materials or training resources for cross-functional teams
Experience in Total Rewards, People Operations, or an adjacent HR domain
Familiarity with PM and collaboration tools (Asana, Jira, or similar)
Familiarity with Total Rewards or HR systems (such as Workday, equity administration platforms, or benefits administration tools)
PMP, Lean/Six Sigma, or comparable structured-program training

Hybrid work at Stripe

This role is available either in an office or a remote location (35+ miles or 56+ km from a Stripe office).

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This hits a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility about how to do this in a way that makes sense for individuals and their teams.

Working remotely at Stripe

A remote location is defined as being 35 miles (56 kilometers) or more from one of our offices. While you would be welcome to come into the office for team/business meetings, on-sites, meet-ups, and events, our expectation is you would regularly work from home rather than a Stripe office. Stripe does not cover the cost of relocating to a remote location. We encourage you to apply for roles that match the location where you currently live or plan to live.

Pay and benefits

The annual US base salary range for this role is $127,600 - $191,400. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. This salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at Stripe and will be narrowed during the interview process based on a number of factors, including the candidate’s experience, qualifications, and location. Applicants interested in this role and who are not located in the US may request the annual salary range for their location during the interview process.

Additional benefits for this role may include: equity, company bonus or sales commissions/bonuses; 401(k) plan; medical, dental, and vision benefits; and wellness stipends.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

jobs.title: Project Manager - Water
jobs.description:
Salary:
£33,000–£68,000 depending on experience

Join a growing Engineering Framework Delivery team delivering high-profile work across our Water Consultancy business. This is an opportunity to support major clean water programmes and help shape the delivery of essential projects that make a real difference to communities across the UK.

Purpose And Scope Of The Role

As Project Manager, you will be responsible for the delivery of multiple client projects within a multi-disciplinary team of engineers, modellers and data analysts. Working closely with Technical Managers and clients, you will manage project planning, governance, reporting, forecasting, technical delivery and financial control. You will lead projects from inception, and proposal through to feasibility, outline, detailed design stages, construction support, handover and closure. You will work to ensure delivery to time, quality and cost while supporting billing, invoicing and wider team coordination.

Your Impact In This Position

You will play a key role in delivering a strong pipeline of water industry projects, supporting AMP8 programmes and beyond. In the short term, you will build trusted relationships, manage active projects and strengthen delivery controls. Over time, you will help improve project processes, support colleagues through training and guidance, and contribute to a high-performing, collaborative culture with real scope for career development.

Core Capabilities

Project delivery leadership – Confidently manage multiple projects at once, ensuring clear objectives, progress tracking and successful outcomes across the full lifecycle.
Technical knowledge– The ideal candidate will have a clear understanding of the various disciplines involved in water project delivery and their relative requirements, skillsets and data needs

This position requires the ability to commute to BRIDGE headquarters in San Francisco, CA, three days per week, with mandatory in-office attendance on Tuesdays. Attendance at off-site meetings, including construction site meetings, is also required.

Manage a portfolio of projects in various phases of development including feasibility and due diligence, planning and entitlement approvals, financing, design and construction, completion and lease-up, closeout and transition to property and asset management.
Evaluate project feasibility through coordination of physical, market, and financial due diligence activities, and initial pro forma analysis.

Manage real estate and finance transactions, including site and property acquisitions, construction and permanent loan closings, and tax credit equity syndications.
Work closely with project consultants and contractors to continuously manage project schedule and total development costs throughout the development process to ensure project financial feasibility and cost control
Supervise and mentor a Project Associate or Associate Project Manager.

Uphold a high quality of development in accordance with BRIDGE’s commitment to the long-term physical, financial, and operational health of its properties, the viability and strength of its portfolio, and the quality of homes for its residents.

Graduate degree in a related field.

Experience in the development of complex housing projects.
Proven affordable housing finance expertise.
Experience with energy-efficient, sustainable, and green building practices.

jobs.description:
Low Voltage Operations Manager - Florida (Div. 27/28)

Company Description

Coranet Corp is a leading national provider of low-voltage solutions, including structured cabling infrastructure, wireless, audio-visual, and physical security (access control and video surveillance). We partner with leading technology brands to design, install, and maintain comprehensive low-voltage systems for our clients' real estate assets. Coranet has been recognized as one of the fastest-growing private businesses on the Inc. 5000 list for four consecutive years. As a certified Women-Owned Small Business, we help organizations modernize their operations and make assets smart, secure, and connected.

Role Description

Coranet is seeking a Florida-based Low Voltage Operations & Project Manager (Div 27/28) located in South Florida / Fort Lauderdale area. Reporting to Coranet's Director of Critical Territories, this role owns the execution and operational performance of Coranet's projects across Florida, with a strong emphasis on ground-up new construction and major renovation builds in multifamily, hospitality, healthcare, industrial, retail, and office environments.

This position is responsible for end-to-end delivery of Div 27/28 low-voltage scope, including structured cabling (copper/fiber), pathways and spaces (IDF/MDF), wireless infrastructure, audio-visual systems, access control, video surveillance, and related integrations, while managing internal field teams, subcontractors, schedules, customer satisfaction, and job profitability. The Florida Operations & Project Manager along with the Operations team serve as the primary point of contact for GCs, owners/clients, consultants, and other project stakeholders once a project begins, ensuring smooth coordination from kickoff through closeout and turnover.

This is a fast-paced, high-ownership role requiring strong construction leadership, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate quickly and effectively via email, text, phone, and in person. The ideal candidate is comfortable with budgeting, forecasting, and margin management and thrives in a growth-oriented environment with autonomy and accountability.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Project & Operations Leadership

Lead and execute Div 27/28 low-voltage projects across Florida, including ground-up new construction, large-scale renovations, and tenant improvements (moves/adds/changes/repairs).
Oversee project planning, schedule management, staffing, and execution to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and on budget.
Serve as Coranet's primary field-facing leader in Florida-driving operational consistency, quality, safety, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
Maintain strong relationships with clients, GCs, consultants, vendors, and subcontractors; ensure a high level of responsiveness and professionalism.

Construction Management (New Development / Builds)

Participate in internal kickoff meetings with Sales, Design, and Engineering to confirm scope, assumptions, milestones, procurement plan, and delivery strategy.
Review drawings, Division 27/28 specifications, and site conditions; identify scope gaps and risks early and coordinate RFIs and clarifications as needed.
Schedule and conduct jobsite walkthroughs with internal teams, subcontractors, GCs, and clients; align installation approach to design intent and construction sequencing.
Coordinate multi-trade interfaces (e.g., electrical power/grounding, pathways, sleeves and firestopping, telecom rooms, door hardware coordination) to support clean installations.

Submittals, Permitting, and Compliance

Manage shop drawings and submittals (including submittal registers when required); coordinate approvals and releases in alignment with project schedule.
Coordinate permit and inspection requirements with AHJs, GCs, and licensed partners as needed; ensure documentation is complete and submitted on time.
Ensure installation meets applicable codes, standards, and project requirements; support inspections and site readiness.

Procurement, Logistics & Material Controls

Review takeoffs and bill of materials for accuracy prior to ordering; plan for long-lead items and align procurement to schedule milestones.
Coordinate ordering and deliveries with internal teams and clients as required; ensure materials are received, logged, staged, and ready prior to install.
Monitor material usage and manage excess/defective material returns and replacements.

Field Team & Subcontractor Management

Lead and support foremen, technicians, and subcontractors; provide direction on priorities, sequencing, quality expectations, and safety requirements.
Monitor field utilization and capacity; develop manpower plans and support hiring/crew scaling aligned with Florida growth.
Manage subcontractor relationships, including selection, negotiation, onboarding, and performance evaluation.

Financial & Performance Management

Own job profitability: track labor hours vs. budget, material costs, equipment costs, and margin performance; implement corrective actions as needed.
Manage change order process: scope documentation, pricing coordination with Sales/Engineering, client review/approval, and internal execution.
Provide clear reporting on milestones, schedule, risks, staffing needs, and financial performance to leadership.

Client Communication & Closeout

Provide daily/weekly status updates to clients/GCs as required by project size and complexity; proactively communicate issues and solutions.
Manage punch lists and closeout activities through final acceptance.
Deliver required turnover documentation, which may include as-builts, labeling/admin, copper/fiber test results, warranties, and O&M materials as required by contract.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree preferred (or equivalent relevant field experience).
6+ years (or 4+ years with strong new construction leadership) in low-voltage construction operations and/or project management with hands-on experience delivering Div 27/28 scope.
Proven track record managing multiple projects simultaneously, including large-scale ground-up builds and major renovations.
Strong technical understanding of:
Structured cabling (Cat6/Cat6A and fiber optics), pathways, risers, IDF/MDF buildouts, and telecom rooms
Wireless infrastructure (WAP layouts/rough-in support), AV infrastructure, access control, and video surveillance systems

Ability to interpret construction documents, blueprints, and technical drawings; electrical background is a plus.
Strong leadership, organization, and communication skills; able to coordinate effectively with internal teams and external stakeholders.
Strong budgeting and analytical skills; comfortable working in Excel and with financial/job cost metrics.
Experience with common construction/project tools (e.g., Procore or similar platforms, Bluebeam) preferred.
Ability to travel to customer sites across Florida as needed.

jobs.title: Sr Technical Program Manager - Adoption and Enablement
jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.
At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.
  Your Impact

Axon is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Program Manager, Adoption & Enablement to drive internal enablement and customer adoption throughout the Fusus lifecycle, with particular focus on training delivery, curriculum development, quality assurance, and post-deployment sustainment support.
This role combines program ownership with hands-on instructor-led training, ensuring both internal Axon teams and external law enforcement customers can successfully adopt Fusus workflows. Success requires the ability to teach not only platform functionality, but also the technical concepts that underpin effective deployments, while translating real-world operational use cases into scalable enablement experiences.
The ideal candidate is a strong cross-functional partner with an operational understanding of Axon Fusus, excellent facilitation skills, and the ability to independently deliver training and enablement. This role is critical in helping customers transition smoothly from deployment to sustainment while maximizing product utilization, operational readiness, and long-term outcomes.
What You’ll Do

Location
: Remote - Scottsdale, AZ, Los Angeles, CA, or San Diego, CA
Travel
: Approximately 50%
Reports to
: Sr. Director, RTO SaaS Delivery
Key Responsibilities

Adoption & Enablement Program Ownership

Own and execute adoption and enablement programs for the Axon Fusus platform across internal and external audiences.

Serve as a trusted authority on Axon Fusus functionality and operational best practices across deployment and sustainment.

Develop and execute training plans aligned with implementation timelines, onboarding needs, and product releases.

Track adoption and readiness outcomes, identify gaps, and implement continuous improvements.

Partner cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Program Management, Enablement leaders, instructional designers, and technical writers to improve training quality and overall enablement effectiveness.

Provide structured feedback from training sessions and customer engagements to inform product usability improvements and adoption strategy.

Curriculum and Internal Enablement

Design, maintain, and continuously improve role-specific curricula for internal stakeholders and customers supporting the Fusus deployment and sustainment lifecycle.

Standardize learning objectives and delivery approaches to ensure consistent and repeatable training experiences.

Train deployment teams and internal cross-functional stakeholders on Fusus functionality, integrations, and deployment considerations.

Enable internal teams to confidently support implementation, integration, and troubleshooting discussions with customers.

Instructor-Led Training Delivery

Deliver high-quality instructor-led training to internal teams and external law enforcement customers.

Facilitate foundational, intermediate, and advanced workflow training with operational and technical context.

Lead scenario-based sessions built around real-world operational use cases.

Independently deliver routine training without reliance on senior program managers.

Develop scalable training programs such as recurring webinars, virtual or in-person seminars, and feature update briefings.

Sustainment, Escalations & Quality Validation

Serve as a post-deployment enablement resource supporting customer sustainment and ongoing adoption.

Act as an escalation point for post-deployment issues, helping reduce support burden on Project Leaders and deployment teams.

Support deployment validation and readiness assessments through checklists, criteria, and quality assurance processes.

Identify recurring issues and translate findings into improvements across training, enablement guidance, and curriculum updates.

Qualifications

Required

Proven experience delivering instructor-led training to professional audiences of more than 50 participants.

Experience developing and executing structured training or enablement programs.

Strong facilitation skills with the ability to engage both technical and operational audiences.

Demonstrated ability to teach functional workflows and applied technical concepts with credibility.

Ability to operate independently in front of customers and internal stakeholders.

Proven ability to improve programs and processes using feedback, performance data, and evolving product or business needs.

Strongly Preferred

Background in law enforcement, public safety, emergency management, or similar operational environments.

Experience training or supporting public-sector customers.

Experience working with video management systems, real-time operations centers, or situational awareness platforms.

Hands-on experience supporting technical deployments or integrations in enterprise environments.

High-level working knowledge of:
IP networking fundamentals

RTSP and video streaming concepts

DVR/NVR systems and camera infrastructure

Network connectivity, ports, firewalls, and bandwidth considerations

Benefits that Benefit You
Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
Discretionary paid time off
Paid parental leave for all
Medical, Dental, Vision plans
Fitness Programs
Emotional & Mental Wellness support
Learning & Development programs
Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

  Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit https://www.axon.com/careers.
Base Pay Range: $131,250 USD - $210,000 USD
Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.
Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
Important Notes

The above job description is not intended as, nor should it be construed as, exhaustive of all duties, responsibilities, skills, efforts, or working conditions associated with this job. The job description may change or be supplemented at any time in accordance with business needs and conditions.
Some roles may also require legal eligibility to work in a firearms environment.

 or via our Axon Privacy Web Form. For more information, please see the Your California Privacy Rights section of our Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice.

All Axon employees must be aware of and committed to the appropriate environmental, health, and safety regulations, policies, and procedures. jobs.description:
Purpose and Impact:

This position is contingent upon award of contract, business needs, security clearance verification, and funding availability. Amentum is seeking an accomplished Program Manager to lead a large, mission-critical intelligence support program for the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA). This executive leader will serve as the Government’s primary point of contact and provide strategic leadership for a geographically dispersed workforce supporting multiple Integrated Intelligence Centers (IICs) across the Defense Intelligence Enterprise.

The Program Manager will oversee all aspects of program execution, including mission performance, workforce management, customer engagement, quality assurance, financial management, transition activities, and operational excellence while ensuring exceptional support to the Government’s evolving intelligence priorities.

Location: National Capital Region (NCR)

Work Schedule:
0600 and 1800 – 8 hours M-F

Essential Responsibilities:

Serve as the primary interface with Government leadership.
Provide executive leadership and strategic direction for all contract operations.
Lead technical, operational, staffing, financial, and business activities.
Manage workforce planning, recruiting, retention, succession planning, and employee development.
Oversee program performance, quality assurance, schedule, cost, and risk management.
Ensure compliance with Intelligence Community Directives (ICDs), Government policies, and contractual requirements.
Lead transition planning, surge operations, and workforce expansion efforts.
Provide executive oversight to Team Leads supporting multiple regional and functional mission portfolios.
Foster collaboration across Government, industry, and Intelligence Community stakeholders.
Promote a mission-focused culture centered on operational excellence, accountability, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):

Active Top Secret/SCI security clearance.
Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution (Master’s degree preferred).
Minimum 15 years of progressively responsible leadership experience supporting the Department of Defense, Intelligence Community, or other national security organizations.
Demonstrated experience serving as a Program Manager or Deputy Program Manager leading contracts supporting more than 200 full-time personnel (FTEs).
Demonstrated experience supporting the Defense Intelligence Agency (DIA), the Defense Intelligence Enterprise (DIE), Combatant Commands, Joint Staff, or other Intelligence Community organizations performing intelligence analysis, mission integration, collection management, or intelligence operations.
Demonstrated success leading geographically dispersed workforces across multiple locations.
Proven experience managing staffing, recruiting, retention, customer relationships, quality assurance, financial performance, subcontractor management, and program risk.
Demonstrated ability to build and lead high-performing teams while fostering employee engagement, professional development, and operational excellence.
Exceptional communication skills with experience briefing Senior Executive Service (SES), General Officers, Flag Officers, or equivalent senior Government leaders.

Security Clearance Required:

Active Top Secret/SCI security clearance

Minimum Education:

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution (Master’s degree preferred).

Minimum Years of Experience:

Minimum 15 years of progressively responsible leadership experience supporting the Department of Defense, Intelligence Community, or other national security organizations.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience supporting DDGI, Integrated Intelligence Centers (IICs), or enterprise intelligence integration missions.
Experience managing intelligence analysis or intelligence-enabling service contracts exceeding 500 FTEs.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification.
Experience leading large-scale contract transitions and workforce stand-up efforts.
Demonstrated record of achieving exceptional employee retention, staffing performance, and customer satisfaction on Intelligence Community contracts.

jobs.description:
Job Description

This Opportunity

The Right-of-Way (ROW) Program Manager/Project Manager
is responsible for leading and overseeing all aspects of ROW project execution and field operations, including project planning, staffing, budgeting, client communication, regulatory coordination, and land acquisition. This role ensures that all activities are executed in compliance with established procedures, legal standards, and client expectations.

Candidates can sit in any of our offices. Texas, Oklahoma, Arkansas, and Louisiana are considered prime locations. This opportunity has multiple openings - apply if you have strong experience in ERCOT, SPP, SWEPCO, varying voltage and LARGE-SCALE.

Your Impact

Key Responsibilities:

Office and Staff Oversight
Select and manage field office operations, if required.
Supervise all project staff, supervisors, and subcontractors; responsible for hiring and releasing field team members.
Assign and schedule all project-related tasks to ensure timely and successful completion.
Ensure adherence to company policies and project procedures by staff and subcontractors.

Project Management

Develop and manage project schedules, budgets, forecasts, and performance metrics.
Monitor project progress and prepare regular status reports, including dashboards, risk assessments, and earned value analysis.
Ensure the quality and accuracy of data and information received from field personnel.
Assist with public outreach efforts and coordination with regulatory agencies for approvals.

Client Relations

Act as the primary point of contact for clients; ensure project objectives and client expectations are met.
Communicate project status, risks, and updates effectively and consistently.

Land Acquisition & Real Estate

Oversee the acquisition of land, rights-of-way, easements, licenses, leases, and permits necessary for the construction and operation of electric transmission/distribution facilities.
Provide guidance on real estate values and accepted appraisal practices to establish fair market value ranges.
Ensure accuracy in the preparation and execution of all land rights documents, including damage claims and rights of entry.

Legal & Regulatory Complianc
e

Maintain a strong understanding of legal documents, property values, environmental issues, and jurisdictional permitting requirements.
Ensure compliance with Limited Title Certificate and Ownership Title Certificate guidelines during title research and acquisition activities.
Oversee the settlement of complex damage claims resulting from construction or maintenance activities.

Who You Are

Required Qualifications

Minimum of 7 years of relevant experience in right-of-way, project management, or related field.
Knowledge of IRWA practices, real estate law, and regulatory permitting processes.
Additional education, licenses, or certifications (e.g., IRWA training) may be considered in meeting experience requirements
ERCOT, SPP, SWEPCO, varying voltages of electric transmission, and LARGE-SCALE experience as a plus for consideration

WSP USA designs lasting solutions in the buildings, transportation, energy, water and environment markets. With more than 15,000 employees in over 300 offices across the U.S., we partner with our clients to help communities prosper.

At WSP, we want to give our employees the challenges they seek to grow their careers and knowledge base. Your daily contributions to your team will be essential in meeting client objectives, goals and challenges. Are you ready to get started?

jobs.title: Project Manager (Defence & Security)
jobs.description:
Job Description

What if you could do the kind of work the world needs?

At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

A Little More About Your Role…

We are looking for Delivery Leads, (Project Managers/Directors and Assistant Project Managers), to manage high-value, challenging projects and programmes within the Defence and Security sector. In this role, you will report to the Senior Delivery Lead and be responsible for delivering projects according to the project plan. Assistant Project Managers will either support larger projects and programmes or take the lead on smaller projects as Project Managers.

We are looking for proactive individuals who can build strong relationships with clients and internal teams to get tasks scoped and delivered to budget, on time and in line with client expectations and the WSP Business Management System. This is a hands-on role that will see you chairing meetings, writing reports, organising resources and monitoring finances.
You will be responsible for traditional project management activities including but not limited to scope and resource management, finance and schedule monitoring, change control, risk management and client management, overlaid with additional requirements of the Defence and Security sector such as security management.
As a growing and diverse team, tackling complex infrastructure projects that span the RIBA design stages.

We are relatively new to the sector and are recruiting following several significant wins with both public and private sector clients. As well as delighting our growing client base we are developing a strong defence and security culture within WSP. In this role you will be expected to support ongoing work winning activities and act as an ambassador for the sector within the business.

We are nationwide and work flexibly between home, WSP and client offices, travelling as required to best deliver the particular needs of the project/programme.

What We Would Be Looking For You To Demonstrate…

Proven experience in the Defence and Security sector in a project/programme management capacity delivering construction or infrastructure projects (not IT Infrastructure) including a demonstrable understanding of working in accordance with security protocols
Knowledge of any of the following:
MOD policy, processes and procedures
Knowledge of the JSPs, in particular JSP 850
The Green Book and 5 case model for business cases

An existing network within the Defence and Security sector
Degree in relevant technical discipline (engineering, building, quantity surveying, science, project or construction management)
Recognised project or programme management qualification from one of the following: PMI, APM, RICS, CIOB
NEC3/4 PM qualification

You must be eligible to achieve Security Clearance.

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.

Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.

Join our close-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.

With us, you can. Apply today.

About Us

We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?

Work-life balance

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.

Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.

Inclusivity & Belonging

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. jobs.description:
Description

Northland Controls is seeking an experienced Embedded Project Manager to support one of our key global technology clients in Nashville, Tennessee. This is an exciting opportunity for a security industry professional who enjoys managing complex infrastructure projects, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, and delivering innovative physical security solutions.

In this role, you will serve as an embedded member of our client's project team, overseeing security infrastructure, facility improvements, and capital construction projects. You'll play a key role in project planning, technical design reviews, contractor coordination, construction oversight, and quality assurance while ensuring projects meet established security standards and operational requirements.

If you're looking for an opportunity to work on high-profile projects, influence security infrastructure design, and make a measurable impact within a growing global organization, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Manage multiple concurrent security infrastructure, facility improvement, and construction-related projects from initial planning through commissioning and closeout.
Serve as a trusted project management and technical resource for our client, coordinating with internal stakeholders, engineering consultants, general contractors, subcontractors, and security vendors.
Develop, review, and refine detailed Scopes of Work (SOW), technical specifications, contractor deliverables, and project requirements.
Review architectural, electrical, security, and low-voltage design drawings to ensure compliance with established security standards and project objectives.
Provide technical guidance on enterprise physical security systems, including access control, video surveillance, security monitoring, and associated infrastructure.
Evaluate contractor proposals, shop drawings, equipment submittals, and change orders to identify scope gaps, design conflicts, technical deficiencies, and potential cost or schedule impacts.
Support security infrastructure planning for new construction, campus expansions, facility renovations, and specialized security environments.
Coordinate security system requirements with architectural, mechanical, electrical, and construction teams to ensure effective design integration and installation.
Monitor project schedules, milestones, contractor performance, and outstanding deliverables while proactively identifying risks and recommending corrective actions.
Conduct site walks and installation inspections to verify compliance with approved drawings, technical specifications, and client security standards.
Develop and maintain project punch lists, track installation deficiencies, and coordinate corrective actions through resolution.
Support system testing, commissioning, operational readiness reviews, and final project turnover to ensure installations meet client expectations.
Review as-built drawings, testing records, commissioning documentation, and other project closeout deliverables for accuracy and completeness.
Lead project coordination meetings, technical discussions, and design reviews while maintaining clear communication and accountability among stakeholders.
Prepare regular project status reports, technical recommendations, and management updates covering milestones, risks, outstanding issues, and project performance.
Maintain accurate project documentation, including drawings, technical reviews, project records, and supporting materials.
Identify opportunities to improve security design standards, contractor coordination, installation quality, and project delivery processes.

What We're Looking For

Significant experience managing complex security infrastructure, construction, or capital improvement projects within the physical security industry.
Strong technical knowledge of enterprise physical security systems, including electronic access control, CCTV/video surveillance, security monitoring, and low-voltage infrastructure.
Experience reviewing security system designs, construction drawings, technical specifications, and contractor submittals.
Demonstrated ability to develop detailed Scopes of Work, evaluate technical proposals, and identify design deficiencies or project risks.
Experience coordinating general contractors, specialty subcontractors, security integrators, engineering consultants, and facility management teams.
Strong understanding of construction project lifecycles, including design development, installation, testing, commissioning, and closeout.
Experience managing project schedules, budgets, change orders, contractor deliverables, and quality assurance activities.
Familiarity with enterprise access control and video management platforms, such as Lenel, Software House, or similar systems, is highly desirable.
PMP certification or equivalent project management credentials preferred.
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with the ability to anticipate challenges and develop practical solutions.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build productive relationships with clients, contractors, and cross-functional teams.
Ability to independently manage multiple priorities and exercise sound judgment in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
Ability to work onsite at client facilities in the Nashville area and travel to other project locations as required.

Why Join Northland Controls?

At Northland Controls, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside some of the world's leading technology companies, supporting sophisticated security infrastructure and capital improvement projects. As an Embedded Project Manager, you'll play an important role in helping our client plan, develop, and maintain security systems that support their evolving business needs.

You'll collaborate with experienced engineering, construction, and security professionals while contributing to projects that require technical expertise, innovative thinking, and a commitment to excellence.

We value innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement—and we're committed to providing opportunities for professional growth in a dynamic, global organization.

providing support to the Command, Control, Communications, and Battle Management Division (C3BM).

Command, Control, Communications, and Battle Management (C3BM) has been tasked with delivering an integrated Department of the Air Force (DAF) Battle Network providing resilient decision advantage and enabling the USAF, USSF, Joint, and Coalition Force to win against the pacing challenge. C3BM supports execution in many different focus areas. C3BM’s main efforts are Architecture and Systems Engineering (ASE), Operational Response Team (ORT), and multiple mission integration teams such as Air, Maritime and multiple acquisitions consisting of both the Advanced Battle Management System (ABMS) and Space.

The DAF PEO C3BM has the responsibility of technically and programmatically integrating the DAF’s larger system-of-systems architecture needed to deliver an integrated Command and Control (C2) core function for the DAF, Joint, and Coalition forces, by teaming with all other DAF PEOs, as needed.

jobs.title: Behavioral Health Program Manager
jobs.description:
Basic Function Of Position

The Behavioral Health Program Manager directs the daily administration and coordination of Unified Fire Authority's Behavioral Health and Wellness Program. The position serves as a primary resource for employees, retirees, and eligible family members seeking assistance; facilitates access to peer support, the Employee Assistance Program (EAP), insurance-based treatment, contracted behavioral health clinicians, and community resources; and provides nonclinical case coordination and follow-up. The position leads the administrative and operational functions of the Peer Support Program, provides knowledgeable guidance to peer support team members within the incumbent's qualifications, and coordinates and, when appropriately trained and qualified, facilitates Behavioral Health After-Action Reviews (BHAARs) and initial critical incident support. The position manages program operations, budgets, contracts, utilization, reporting, and continuous improvement. Routine counseling, psychotherapy, diagnosis, and ongoing clinical treatment are not functions of this position.

Supervision Received

Works under the general direction of the Health and Safety Battalion Chief, exercising independent judgment within established UFA policies and delegated authority. Clinical consultation is obtained from appropriately licensed professionals when needed.

Supervision Exercised

Provides operational coordination and program direction to Peer Support Team members; formal personnel supervisory authority, if any, will be established by UFA.

Principal Responsibilities

The essential functions of this position include, but are not limited to, the following duties and responsibilities:

Manages daily operations of the Behavioral Health and Wellness Program and implements approved policies, procedures, service pathways, and administrative processes.
Receives requests from employees, retirees, family members, and other individuals seeking assistance; explains available resources and coordinates timely referrals to peer support, EAP, insurance-based providers, contracted clinicians, or community services.
Coordinates nonclinical intake, program eligibility verification, service authorizations, scheduling, resource navigation, and appropriate follow-up; refers clinical assessment and treatment decisions to qualified providers.
Oversees administrative operations of the Peer Support Program, including team coordination, recruitment support, onboarding, training schedules, records, and program evaluation.
Serves as a knowledgeable consultation resource to Peer Support team members on program protocols, boundaries, referral pathways, and recognition of concerns requiring clinical or emergency escalation; obtains licensed clinical consultation when appropriate.
Coordinates with Operations Battalion Chiefs in responding to significant or potentially traumatic incidents, including peer support mobilization, BHAAR scheduling, logistical support, and follow-up resources; facilitates BHAARs only within documented training and qualifications.
Develops and coordinates behavioral health education and outreach initiatives to increase awareness of available resources, reduce barriers to accessing services, and promote early intervention and employee wellness.
Serves as a member of the department's Health & Wellness committee.
Maintains relationships with EAP, health plan resources, contracted behavioral health clinicians, and other partners; identifies service gaps and coordinates access to specialized care.
Manages provider administrative agreements, service authorizations, invoicing, utilization limits, and vendor coordination in accordance with UFA policy.
Maintains confidential administrative records and secure referral/utilization tracking; limits collection and disclosure of clinical information to what is authorized and necessary.
Prepares aggregate program reports and evaluates referral patterns, access barriers, utilization, costs, and opportunities for improvement without disclosing identifiable treatment information.
Assists the Health and Safety Battalion Chief with budget planning, expenditure tracking, purchasing, invoice reconciliation, and financial reporting.
Identifies grant opportunities, coordinates applications, and administers grant reporting and compliance.
Coordinates training, outreach, employee education, meetings, correspondence, travel, and related administrative functions.
Participates in development and periodic review of peer support, BHAAR, referral, confidentiality, and crisis escalation procedures with leadership, legal counsel, and qualified clinical advisors.
Serves as the Mental Health Resources Liaison (MHRL) in accordance with Utah code.
Performs other duties of a similar nature or level.

Typical Decisions

Prioritizes program activities, referral logistics, provider coordination, and operational follow-up within established policy.
Determines when matters must be elevated to the Health and Safety Battalion Chief, emergency services, or an appropriately licensed behavioral health clinician.
Recommends process, budget, training, and resource improvements; does not independently diagnose, prescribe treatment, or make clinical fitness-for-duty determinations.

Minimum Requirements

Bachelor's degree in social work, psychology, behavioral health, human services, healthcare administration, public administration, or a closely related field; equivalent education and relevant experience may be considered.
Three years of relevant experience in behavioral health program operations, care coordination, crisis support, peer support administration, or closely related work, including demonstrated program coordination responsibilities.
Valid driver's license.
Completion of UFA-approved peer support and critical incident response training within a timeframe established by UFA.

Desirable Qualifications

Master's degree in social work, counseling, psychology, or a related behavioral-health field.
Utah social-work or behavioral-health credential.
Experience with firefighters, law enforcement, EMS, military, veterans, or other public-safety populations.
Experience with crisis intervention, trauma-informed care, substance-use resources, and behavioral-health resource navigation.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Knowledge of first responder behavioral health, peer support principles, crisis escalation, referral resources, confidentiality, and professional boundaries.
Ability to communicate compassionately and professionally with people in distress while remaining within a non-treatment role.
Ability to organize multiple priorities, maintain secure records, analyze utilization and budget data, administer contracts, and prepare reports.
Proficiency with office productivity software, scheduling systems, and secure program recordkeeping; ability to learn new technology.
Ability to coordinate effectively with UFA leadership, peer supporters, clinicians, EAP, insurers, and community partners.

Work Environment

Work is performed in a general office environment during routine office hours, Monday through Friday. However, occasional evening, weekend, and on-scene or station response may be required for significant incidents, peer support activities, training, or BHAAR coordination. Availability and response expectations will be defined by UFA.

Physical And Mental Job Requirements

Work includes prolonged computer use, verbal and written communication, review of sensitive information, occasional driving, and occasional lifting of up to ten (10) pounds. The position requires sound judgment and the ability to respond professionally to emotionally difficult situations. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals to perform essential functions.

This position is classified as Category A under UFA Policy 100-240 UFA Cell Phone Policy.

This position is classified as Category B under UFA Policy 1100-020 Staff Vehicle Assignment, Use and Reimbursement

Classified as non-exempt and eligible for overtime.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager
jobs.description:
CEL Critical Power is an Irish-based manufacturer, distributor, and exporter of electrical switchgear, controls, and related products and services, with a 40-year track record, focused on supplying the global data center industry.

Operating from Ireland and in support of our 400,000 sq ft of manufacturing capacity in Williamsburg, Virginia, we aim to double in size each year for the next three years.

As part of this ambitious growth journey, we are seeking an experienced Senior Project Manager to lead the delivery of complex, high-value customer projects across our international operations while managing and developing a team of Project Managers responsible for multiple concurrent projects.

About The Role

This is a senior, customer-facing delivery role with responsibility for a portfolio of projects, senior stakeholder relationships, financial performance, and the leadership of Project Managers. You will provide oversight across multiple projects while retaining direct accountability for major or strategically important customer engagements.

Working across Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Commercial, Finance, and Project Management teams, you will ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, within scope and budget, and to the required quality standards. You will provide clear financial and performance reporting, proactively manage risk and change, and ensure strong governance across the project portfolio.

Working closely with teams in Ireland and the United States, you will support consistent project delivery across the organization, strengthen customer relationships, and develop the capability and performance of the Project Management team.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex, high-value customer projects, ensuring commitments are achieved across scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, and customer expectations.
Provide oversight across multiple concurrent projects, monitoring dependencies, priorities, risks, resources, and overall delivery performance.
Manage, coach, and develop a team of Project Managers, setting clear expectations and supporting consistent, high-quality project execution.
Act as a senior point of contact for customers, building trusted relationships and leading project reviews, escalations, negotiations, and key delivery discussions.
Engage with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to provide clear project updates, recommendations, and escalation of issues requiring business decisions.
Establish and maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, governance routines, and success criteria aligned with customer commitments and CEL objectives.
Own and report on project and portfolio financial performance, including budgets, forecasts, cash flow, cost-to-complete, change impacts, margin, and profitability.
Identify financial variances and delivery risks early, implementing recovery actions to protect customer commitments and commercial outcomes.
Lead contract, scope, and change management, ensuring variations are assessed, approved, documented, and reflected in project cost and schedule forecasts.
Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Commercial, and Finance to align design readiness, material availability, production capacity, commercial requirements, and delivery plans.
Ensure project risks, issues, actions, and decisions are actively managed, with robust contingency planning and timely escalation where required.
Oversee subcontractor, supplier, and external delivery performance where relevant, ensuring quality, cost, schedule, and compliance requirements are met.
Lead executive and customer project performance reviews, providing accurate reporting, clear insights, and practical recommendations.
Drive consistent project management standards, reporting discipline, lessons learned, and continuous improvement across the team.
Ensure projects comply with applicable technical, quality, safety, regulatory, contractual, and customer requirements.

Skills, Experience & Qualifications

10+ years of experience in project management within industrial, engineering, manufacturing, construction, infrastructure, or engineered product environments.
Proven experience leading complex, high-value customer projects from initial handover through planning, execution, delivery, and close-out.
Experience managing or leading Project Managers responsible for multiple concurrent projects.
Strong customer-facing experience, including senior stakeholder engagement, project reviews, issue resolution, negotiation, and escalation management.
Demonstrated ownership of project financial reporting, including budgeting, forecasting, cost control, cost-to-complete, cash flow, margin, profitability, and change impacts.
Strong understanding of project governance, scheduling, risk management, change control, contract management, and performance reporting.
Commercially astute, with the ability to balance customer requirements, technical considerations, delivery constraints, and financial objectives.
Excellent leadership and people-development skills, with the ability to build accountability and consistent performance across a project team.
Excellent communication, problem-solving, negotiation, and decision-making skills.
Ability to operate effectively with senior management, customers, and cross-functional teams across multiple sites or regions.
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Construction Management, Business, or a related discipline.
Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
Willingness to travel between CEL sites and customer locations as required.

Desirable

Experience in power systems, electrical infrastructure, switchgear, data centers, pharmaceuticals, industrial operations, modular solutions, or a comparable engineered sector.
Experience delivering projects across multiple sites or international operations.
Knowledge of project delivery in an engineer-to-order or manufacturing environment.
Experience with customer contracts, claims, variations, and commercial negotiations.
Knowledge of US electrical industry practices, including UL standards and NEC codes.
Recognised project management certification, such as PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent.
Experience using project controls, ERP, reporting, or data-analysis tools to improve visibility and forecasting.

Why Join CEL Critical Power?

Join a Trusted Industry Leader – 42 Years of Excellence CEL has been delivering high-quality, bespoke power distribution solutions for over four decades, with products that stand the test of time.
Be Part of a Global Expansion With CEL launching its first US manufacturing plant, you will have the opportunity to work on international projects and documentation standards while collaborating with colleagues across North America.
Collaborate with World-Class Engineers, Vendors & Industry Experts You’ll work alongside leading engineers, project managers, document controllers, product managers, and global vendors, ensuring excellence and operational success across CEL’s international teams.
Shape the Future of CEL – Critical Power This is more than just an operator role—it’s an opportunity to help forge the future of CEL and our expansion across the US.

Professional development and career advancement opportunities
Dynamic and innovative work environment

Lead complex air quality permitting, compliance, and modeling projects for industrial and energy sector clients nationwide.

Demonstrated experience managing complex projects and client relationships with responsibility for scope, schedule, budget, and profitability.
Strong expertise in PSD, NSR, Title V permitting, emissions inventories, and regulatory compliance evaluations.
Advanced experience using AERMOD and other air quality modeling platforms such as CALPUFF.
Extensive experience working with environmental regulatory agencies.

Strong business development, proposal preparation, and client relationship management experience.

Master’s Degree is preferred.
Essential professional licensure/certification.
Advanced experience in atmospheric science, meteorological analysis, or air quality modeling.
Experience with AERMOD, CALPUFF, and other regulatory modeling platforms.

jobs.title: Business Analyst Technico-Fonctionnel H/F
jobs.description:
En tant que Business Analyst Technico-Fonctionnel, tu interviendras au cœur des projets de transformation applicative de nos clients du secteur Assurance / Mutuelle, principalement basés sur le bassin niortais.

Au sein de squads agiles, tu accompagneras le Product Owner et les équipes de développement dans la compréhension, la formalisation et la mise en œuvre des besoins métiers.

Tes Principales Missions

Collecter, challenger et formaliser les besoins métiers
Traduire ces besoins en spécifications fonctionnelles et techniques
Participer à la gestion du backlog produit et à la priorisation des user stories
Collaborer avec les équipes de développement, test et UX/UI
Participer aux phases de recette, de test et de formation des utilisateurs
Garantir la cohérence fonctionnelle des solutions dans un environnement applicatif complexe.

Tu disposes d’une expérience solide dans les métiers applicatifs, idéalement acquise en tant que développeur ou testeur. À l’aise dans les environnements techniques, tu maîtrises Java, les API, SQL ainsi que des outils tels que Jira ou Squash, ce qui te permet d’échanger efficacement avec les équipes IT.

Tu connais bien le secteur des mutuelles et de l’assurance, et une expérience significative sur le bassin niortais constitue un prérequis pour ce poste.

Rejoindre SII Atlantique
, c’est intégrer une communauté de 260 ingénieurs animés par le collectif, le partage et la convivialité.

Tu évolueras auprès de clients Grands Comptes, PME et ETI, ce qui te permettra de développer des compétences techniques, fonctionnelles et méthodologiques variées.

Tu bénéficieras d’un accompagnement personnalisé grâce à tes référents — manager, RH, administratif — ainsi que de formations régulières et de nombreux espaces d’échange où tes idées ont toute leur place, comme les Speak Ups, ateliers ou réunions d’agence.

La vie d’agence, c’est aussi des moments conviviaux : petits-déjeuners, afterworks, soirées, événements sportifs, et une intégration soignée dès ton arrivée.

Côté avantages, tu profites d’un positionnement salarial juste et équitable, de la participation, des tickets restaurant, d’une mutuelle et des services du CSE. Des chèques vacances et de fin d’année complètent le dispositif, tout comme dix jours de RTT et un accord de télétravail.

Les déplacements sont facilités grâce aux indemnités kilométriques vélo ou à la prise en charge à 75 % des transports, et des solutions de crèche sont proposées. L’agence s’inscrit également dans une démarche pro‑vélo avec ateliers de réparation et communauté vélotaf, et s’engage dans des actions solidaires, du mécénat de compétences et le soutien aux acteurs locaux.

Qui sommes-nous ?

Le groupe SII est au cœur de l’innovation au service de grands comptes dans des secteurs d’ingénierie variés. En 2026, pour la 9ème année consécutive, SII France a obtenu le label Great Place To Work®.

Ce succès est le reflet de notre culture basée sur notre volonté de proposer à tous nos salariés un cadre de travail épanouissant pour le développement de leurs compétences et carrières.

Rejoindre SII, c’est s’engager dans une aventure collective : Let’s Tech Together !

Cette promesse représente notre ambition commune : construire un futur technologique ensemble, dans un cadre où l'expérimentation et l'autonomie sont encouragées, où les innovations sont au cœur de nos actions, et où chaque collaborateur trouve épanouissement professionnel et responsabilisation au sein d'un collectif enthousiaste et inclusif.

En tant que société à fortes valeurs humaines, nous sommes signataires de la Charte d'engagement LGBT+ avec l'Association l'autre Cercle et sommes une entreprise Handi-accueillante.

Let’s Tech Together incarne ce que nous sommes et ce que nous aspirons à être : une entreprise dynamique, innovante et humaine. Alors si ces valeurs vous parlent, rejoignez-nous !
