jobs.title: Manager, Strategy Analyst
jobs.description:
161 Bay Street (93021), Canada, Toronto,Toronto, Ontario,Manager, Strategy Analyst

About Capital One Canada

For 30 years, we’ve been on a mission to change banking for good. We challenge the traditional bank stereotype, fostering a culture where innovation thrives and bold ideas are celebrated.

We pair data-driven strategy with the autonomy to take ownership of complex, high-impact challenges.

You’ll be encouraged to own your work from end-to-end and challenge the status quo to build solutions that impact the lives of millions of Canadians, because at Capital One we analyze and innovate. You’ll be empowered to grow and develop in an environment that balances high-performance standards with a genuine investment in your long-term success. If you’re ready to redefine what’s possible and drive exponential growth, this is where you can create what’s next.

About The Team

Yes, we’re a credit card company, but we’re more than that too. With your help, we’ll build the next generation of banking in Canada based on customer-focused values, compelling products and great engineering. Our Strategy & Analytics Team is like management consulting, but better. From day one, you’ll bring strategies to life through end-to-end delivery, measuring their impact through testing and monitoring, being accountable for both Profit & Loss and customer outcomes.

You’ll lead a team of analysts to solve complex problems and make data-driven decisions by gathering and analyzing data, testing hypotheses and developing insights and recommendations to the business. You’ll provide thought leadership to the team to ensure the highest quality of analytical and conceptual output.

Working in agile, cross-functional teams, you’ll have the opportunity to learn from others like Data Scientists, Process Managers and Brand Strategists too. And you’ll do it all in a collaborative environment where insight is valued, innovation is rewarded and continuous learning is promoted.

Our Business Managers play leadership roles in every part of our business, identifying opportunities to grow our business with our customers. Some example Business Manager roles include:

Marketing Strategy Lead: Optimize our strategies on how we acquire new customers. Leverage a testing mindset to help analysts and marketers find the channels and messages that best resonate with customers.
Fraud Strategy Lead: Lead a team of analysts to develop cutting edge models and fraud prevention strategies. Leverage innovative tools and analytics to make fraud experiences frictionless for customers.
Product Strategy Lead: Lead a cross-functional team to develop new products from ideation to execution. Dive deep into customer needs through research and analysis.
Credit Strategy Lead: Lead a team developing our models and credit policies that enable us to provide access to credit to the right customers. Balance credit modeling, economic trends, and business strategy in optimizing the credit strategies of what cards and terms to offer customers.

This posting is the general posting for all of our Business Manager roles. As we get to know you through the interview process, we’ll work with you to identify the perfect role for you.

Your Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership: Develop business strategies that will drive growth, profitability, and competitive success for Capital One in the face of shifting customer and regulatory demands.
People Management: Coach and mentor associates with a goal of developing and retaining talent at Capital One. Lead in an inclusive work environment, where teamwork, diversity and belonging are essential.
Product: Develop and implement new product and pricing strategies for various lending products; lead product-level modeling and analytics.
Marketing: Develop direct-to-consumer marketing strategy and initiatives to support business growth objectives. Help build targeted insights to inform the design and development of new customer experiences, as well as breakthrough technology and concepts designed to deliver new go-to-market strategies.
Credit Risk: Support step-change improvements in credit performance by connecting drivers of future consumer credit trends to historical behaviour, creating risk models, and testing hypotheses using rigorous monitoring and analysis.
End-to-End Delivery: Collaborate with cross-functional partners in data science, process management, engineering and others to imagine great strategies on paper, and deliver them to market with quality.

Basic Qualifications:

5+ years of work experience with demonstrated ability to drive business strategy from inception to implementation, working with cross-functional teams.
2 years of people leadership experience (direct or indirect).
Strong analytical skills, with experience using coding and data visualization tools (SQL, Python, Tableau and QuickSight).
Sound functional knowledge of strategy development and execution.
Ability to work effectively with associates at all levels in an organization.

Preferred Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university with a specialization in Commerce, Finance, Marketing, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, Statistics or related field
2 years of direct people leadership experience
5+ years of experience in consulting or financial services
5+ years of experience in data and/or quantitative analysis

Working at Capital One

You’ll be empowered to take end-to-end ownership of your work and your career, backed by a high-performance, hybrid culture and holistic suite of benefits designed to support your whole self.

Take ownership of your own potential:

Whether you’re looking to upskill, pivot into new business areas, or master your craft, you’ll have access to tools and mentorship to reach your potential and define your career trajectory.

Find your rhythm:

We believe trust fosters the flexibility and autonomy required to balance personal needs with a focus on high performance. We support a hybrid model – with 3 days in the office per week – that gives room for both collaboration and personal commitments.

Benefits built for your life:

We take a holistic approach to well-being, providing support for you and those who are most important to you. This includes: full coverage for spouses, domestic partners and dependents, a one-time Work From Home allowance to build your comfortable workspace, up to $3,000 in mental health coverage and up to $5,000 in annual tuition subsidies.

You’ll find that Capital One is committed to helping you thrive and evolve every step of the way.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

The expected annual salary range for this position is $157,400 - $179,600. This role is also eligible to earn performance-based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es). Incentives could be discretionary or non-discretionary depending on the plan.

We embrace the responsible use of artificial intelligence (AI) to enhance the candidate experience and streamline our recruitment processes. However, no hiring decisions are made using AI as every hiring decision is made by our hiring managers, business interviewers, and recruitment professionals. Our teams are equipped with training that empowers them to use AI responsibly.

Capital One Canada is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We consider all qualified applicants and will meet the needs of those requiring reasonable accommodations.

If you have visited our website in search of information on employment opportunities or to apply for a position, and you require an accommodation, please contact Capital One Recruiting at 1-800-304-9102 or via email at ARCanada@capitalone.com. All information you provide will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.

For technical support or questions about Capital One's recruiting process, please send an email to Careers@capitalone.com

Capital One does not provide, endorse nor guarantee and is not liable for third-party products, services, educational tools or other information available through this site.

Please note that any position posted in Canada is for Capital One Canada, any position posted in the United Kingdom is for Capital One Europe and any position posted in the Philippines is for Capital One Philippines Service Corp. jobs.description:

Job Summary

Castalia Systems is seeking an Open-Source Intelligence Analyst, Junior, to support our Intelligence Client’s mission sets.

Roles And Responsibilities

A qualified candidate will perform the following duties and responsibilities, but are not limited to:

Conduct OSINT activities in response to Government Request for Information (RFI) or tasking by the OIC including working with the Government to clarify and refine the RFI, collecting, exploiting, and analyzing-online open-source information, and preparing a report in the format required by the task, with minimal supervision using commercial internet, NIPRNet, SIPRNet and SCINet systems and tools.
Populate and maintain databases in support of and in conjunction with Data Analysts and Data Scientists.
Document types and structure of open-source data, analyze and mine data to identify patterns and correlations, map and trace data from system to system or source to source, design and create data reports.
Assist the OSINT Team in using and evaluating available Commercial Off-The-Shelf (COTS) tools.
Employ COTS tools to aggregate, structure, visualize, and assess available open-source information; infer and assess the relevance, veracity, and credibility of the information and its source.
Employ managed attribution (MA) software and associated online tradecraft while executing OSINT collection activities; demonstrate an understanding of the limitations of MA tools.
Develop innovative ways to combine data from different tools to provide analytical results that are of greater value and relevance to Operational Forces.
Train and mentor Marines in OSINT tradecraft and best practices, including the ability to administer MCIA’s Expeditionary OSINT Course.
Identify, develop, and formalize new OSINT tradecraft and other SOPs to meet mission requirement.
Develops open-source research strategies to support specific information gaps.
Manually search for, exploit and analyze a variety of online open sources to include media, social media, academic literature, videos, maps etc. in target language to augment information acquired through other sources and/or to fill information gaps.
Use various tools and methods to determine authenticity and currency of information acquired from the Internet.
Create reports using Word and PowerPoint to convey research findings; generate Open-Source Intelligence Reports (OSIRs).
Verbally brief findings and research methods to various consumers.
Use language skills to conduct searches and translate foreign articles, journals, and other forms of media into English.
Participate in meetings, conferences, and exercises.

Required Qualifications

Minimum 3 years of experience conducting analysis relevant to the specific labor category, with at least a portion of the experience within the last 2 years.
Bachelor’s degree in an area related to the labor category from a college or university accredited by an agency recognized by the U.S. Department of Education. An additional 4 years of experience in the specific labor category, for a total of 7 years of experience in lieu of degree.
Candidates will have completed a joint-accredited OSINT course. Joint-accredited OSINT courses include but are not limited to: EOSINT (USMC), OS301 and OS302 (Army), ONI OSINT Fundamentals Course (Navy), Introduction to OSINT (USAF), DIA BOTC (DIA), NGA OSINT Course (NGA), NERD (SOCOM). Commercial alternatives to a joint-accredited OSINT course include but are not limited to: CASO (Black Horse Solutions), and SEC 497 and SEC 587 (SANS Institute).

Physical Requirements/Work Environment

Normal office environment.
During high-tempo operations, maintain situational awareness and relay intelligence in real time.

Travel

Not required.

Compensation

At Castalia Systems, we provide you with opportunities and choices and support your total well-being. Our benefits include: Medical, dental, vision coverage, 401k matching, generous PTO, paid holidays, professional training opportunities, and even pet insurance to ensure your furry friends are cared for too. All regularly scheduled employees working at least 30 hours per week are eligible to participate in Castalia Systems’ benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits.

Salary at Castalia Systems is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, position knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $70,000.00 to $75,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Castalia Systems’ total compensation package for employees.

Position Summary

We are seeking a Payments Operations Analyst to support the Sony Engagement Platform, helping Sony operating companies consume Sony Enteractive Entertainment's payment orchestration capabilities and related commerce services globally. This role sits at the intersection of platform operations and OpCo activation, focusing on payment performance monitoring, operational reporting, onboarding readiness, issue coordination, testing support and process documentation.

The successful candidate will work closely with Sony Interactive Entertainment Global Payments, Sony Engagement Platform, product, engineering, risk, fraud and regional business teams to help ensure payment services are operationally reliable, measurable and scalable. This role requires strong attention to detail, analytical curiosity, sound operational judgement and the ability to turn payment data and operational feedback into clear actions.

Overall, we are looking for an individual who is passionate about our brand and what they do, has a high sense of integrity and excels in building strong relationships by deeply caring about others, including our customers.

Job Responsibilities

Monitor payment performance, transaction trends and operational indicators for Sony operating companies, producing operational reporting and issue tracking that helps identify anomalies, processing issues, customer friction and optimisation opportunities.

jobs.description:
Job Summary

This hybrid day shift role for a Cyber Security Analyst focuses on assessing and managing technology risk across enterprise systems while supporting business operations. The analyst will apply deep risk management experience to safeguard critical assets strengthen control environments and reduce exposure to evolving cyber threats. Experience in check processing domains is beneficial for understanding financial transaction risks and ensuring secure compliant operations.

Responsibilities

Assess enterprise technology environments to identify cyber risks and control gaps applying risk management practices to prioritize remediation efforts that protect critical systems and data.
Develop and maintain comprehensive risk registers that clearly document vulnerabilities threat scenarios impact ratings and mitigation plans to support transparent risk decisions by stakeholders.
Conduct detailed risk assessments for new and existing applications infrastructure changes and third party services to ensure cyber risk is evaluated before deployment or integration.
Collaborate with security engineering and operations teams to define practical risk reduction actions translate findings into clear requirements and ensure mitigation steps align with business needs.
Monitor security alerts risk indicators and incident trends to detect emerging risk patterns and provide timely recommendations that strengthen defenses and reduce recurrence.
Coordinate periodic control testing and validation activities to verify that implemented risk treatments are effective measurable and aligned with internal standards and regulatory obligations.
Prepare concise risk reports and dashboards for management that highlight key risk drivers residual exposure levels and the progress of remediation initiatives across technology domains.
Support policy and standard development by providing input based on observed risks and incidents ensuring that documented expectations are practical and aligned with recognized security frameworks.
Advise project teams during system design and change initiatives to embed appropriate security controls ensuring risk considerations are addressed early and reducing the need for costly rework.
Engage with business stakeholders to explain cyber risk in clear terms enabling informed decisions that balance protective measures with operational efficiency and customer impact.
Apply knowledge of payment and transaction flows especially in check processing environments to identify fraud and operational risks and propose control enhancements that secure financial operations.
Contribute to continuous improvement by documenting lessons learned from assessments and near miss events recommending updates to risk methodologies tools and processes for better outcomes.
Maintain accurate and current documentation of risk management activities methodologies and outcomes to support audits compliance reviews and organizational learning.

Qualifications

Demonstrate five to seven years of professional experience in cyber security roles focused on risk management including practical exposure to risk assessment mitigation planning and control evaluation.
Possess strong knowledge of core risk management concepts such as likelihood analysis impact determination control effectiveness and residual risk calculation within technology environments.
Apply familiarity with industry security frameworks and standards using them as references for designing and assessing controls across applications networks and data handling processes.
Exhibit analytical skills to interpret complex technical information security alerts and vulnerability data translating them into understandable risk statements and prioritized actions.
Utilize excellent communication abilities to prepare clear documentation risk reports and stakeholder updates that support decision making and foster shared understanding of cyber exposures.
Bring working knowledge of financial or payment processing domains including check processing to enhance understanding of transaction risks and to guide secure process and system design.

jobs.description:
Amentum is seeking a driven and professional Epidemiology Operations Senior Analyst
to work on the PACOM Command Surgeon’s (J07) Decision Support Team (DST). This position serves as the DST's senior expert for infectious-disease surveillance, population-health trends, and epidemiological risk, acting as a primary liaison with civilian health agencies, academia, and foreign partners. The Analyst leads wastewater-based epidemiology and integrates public health, biosurveillance, wastewater, open-source, operational, and classified information to identify anomalies and assess force-health and mission effects. General public health experience without applied epidemiological or biosurveillance expertise is insufficient. Assigned to J85, the position directly supports J07, entails hybrid work from Camp Smith and other local locations, receives functional priorities from J07 through established contract channels, operates with project and technical oversight from J85, and reports administratively to the Amentum Project Lead.

Essential Responsibilities
:

Analyze epidemiological, public-health, wastewater, biosurveillance, operational, open-source, and classified information to identify trends, anomalies, clusters, and emerging threats.
Lead wastewater-surveillance baseline, indicator, trend, and anomaly-threshold development with laboratory, public-health, and CBRNE specialists.
Assess the significance, reliability, limitations, uncertainty, and operational implications of epidemiological findings.
Provide findings to the Operations Planner for integration with medical intelligence, CBRNE analysis, Force Health Protection, and operational plans.
Monitor emerging infectious diseases and public-health threats across the US PACOM AOR using DoW, interagency, state, foreign-government, and partner data.
Support epidemiological investigations and assessments in coordination with authorized DoW medical and public-health personnel.
Coordinate with J07, subordinate commands, theater public-health organizations, overseas laboratories, intelligence analysts, military planners, and external partners.
Test the Biosurveillance Information Platform and provide epidemiology-specific findings for Military Utility Assessments and recommendations.
Translate surveillance needs into requirements for technical teams developing feeds, dashboards, alerts, and workflows; coding is not required.
Develop surveillance protocols, data-quality standards, analytic methods, reports, white papers, and capability-improvement recommendations.

Bachelor's degree or higher in epidemiology, public health, biostatistics, health science, or a closely related discipline.
Must have an active Secret security clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain a Secret Clearance.
7+ years of progressively responsible experience in epidemiology, public health surveillance, disease monitoring, outbreak analysis, or a related field.
Experience independently analyzing complex surveillance data and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
Knowledge of epidemiological design, surveillance methods, statistical concepts, disease-activity measures, data quality, and uncertainty.
Familiarity with military planning and ability to work with military planners, intelligence professionals, technical teams, and decision-makers.
Strong writing, consultation, coordination, and senior-leader briefing skills.
Active Top-Secret security clearance, with SCI eligibility later during employment.
Master of Public Health or another relevant master's degree; wastewater-based epidemiology experience.
DoW, Combatant Command, public-health agency, or infectious-disease surveillance experience.
Knowledge of microbiology, pathophysiology, syndromic surveillance, and emerging diseases.
Indo-Pacific experience and familiarity with AI-enabled tools, Maven Smart System, or biosurveillance platforms.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance) –
jobs.description:
Company

Cogent Communications is a global, Tier 1 facilities-based ISP, consistently ranked as one of the top five networks in the world and is publicly traded on the NASDAQ Stock Market under the ticker symbol CCOI. Cogent specializes in providing businesses with high speed Internet access and Ethernet transport services. Cogent's facilities-based, all-optical IP network backbone provides IP services globally. Since its inception, Cogent has unleashed the benefits of IP technology, building one of the largest and highest capacity IP networks in the world. This network enables Cogent to offer large bandwidth connections at highly competitive prices. Cogent also offers superior customer support by virtue of its end-to-end control of service delivery and network monitoring. A competitive base salary and a full benefits package including; Health, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off (PTO), Short and Long Term Disability, Life Insurance, Holidays, Parental Leave, 401(k) plan with employer match, stock options, and an Employee Assistance Program. Most benefits take effect within 30 days of employment, and some require a waiting period.

Job Summary

The Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance)
is responsible for protecting the organization's information assets, technology infrastructure, applications, cloud environments, data, and artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives from cyber threats and misuse. This role serves as a key contributor to both cybersecurity operations and AI governance programs by identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating risks associated with Information Systems as well as AI-enabled technologies.

The Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance) works closely with IT teams, software developers, business stakeholders, and external partners to ensure cybersecurity and AI initiatives align with security policies, industry standards, regulatory requirements, and emerging AI governance frameworks. This position will work closely with the CIO/CISO functions to provide a cohesive plan for cybersecurity initiatives, AI governance, Shadow AI oversight, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Compensation

[Starting / Initial] Base Salary Pay Range: $110,000 - $130,000

Specific offers within the listed pay ranges are determined by a variety of factors such as experience, education, skills, certifications and business needs.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Monitor security systems, networks, applications, cloud platforms, and AI-enabled services for suspicious activity and potential threats.
Perform security assessments and risk analyses of systems, applications, AI solutions, and business processes.
Assist in the development, implementation, and continuous improvements of cybersecurity and AI governance policies, standards, procedures, and controls.
Collaborate with IT, software development, and business teams to implement security best practices and controls (security-by-design principles and secure technology solutions)
Participate in the review, risk assessment, and governance oversight of internally developed AI solutions, machine learning models, and employee-driven AI initiatives.
Evaluate third-party AI vendors, applications, and services for cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, data protection, and operational risks.
Identify, assess, and monitor risks associated with generative AI, large language models (LLMs), machine learning platforms, prompt injection attacks, data leakage, insecure APIs, and AI supply chain vulnerabilities.
Assist with the development and administration of the organization's AI governance and Shadow AI oversight programs.
Support secure development practices for internally developed applications and AI-enabled solutions, and emerging technology initiatives.
Participate in security awareness and AI awareness training initiatives for employees.
Assist with audits, compliance reviews, AI governance assessments, and regulatory reporting requirements.
Research emerging cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, cybersecurity trends, AI technologies, and industry best practices and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies/countermeasures.
Maintain inventories of approved AI solutions, AI vendors, and AI-related business initiatives.
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, metrics, risk assessments, and documentation related to cybersecurity operations, AI governance, compliance and enterprise risk management activities.

Qualifications

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Risk Management, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
Minimum of 2–5 years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, GRC, application security, vendor risk, privacy, IT audit, compliance, technology governance, or a related discipline.
Experience performing technology, security, vendor, application, privacy, or operational risk assessments.
Experience developing, interpreting, implementing, or supporting technology policies, standards, procedures, or governance processes.
Experience evaluating new technologies, applications, vendors, or services from a risk and security perspective.
Experience working collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document risks and develop recommendations for both technical and executive audiences.
Demonstrated interest in artificial intelligence, generative AI, responsible AI adoption, and emerging technology risk.
Familiarity with generative AI, machine learning concepts, large language models (LLMs), or AI-enabled business applications.

Proficient In The Following Areas

Familiarity with AI governance principles and emerging AI risk management frameworks.
AI governance concepts and risks associated with generative AI technologies.
Data protection, data classification, privacy, and appropriate data use.
Knowledge of application security concepts, API security, and secure software development practices.
Understanding of risks associated with generative AI platforms, LLMs, prompt injection, data privacy, and AI model security.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to independently research emerging technologies and translate findings into practical recommendations.
Ability to write and present formal documentation, risk assessments, and executive-level reports.
Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including CIS Controls, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and security best practices.
Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) tools and security monitoring platforms is a PLUS.
Experience supporting software development, DevSecOps, or application security initiatives is a PLUS.

Preferred Certifications

Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC)
CompTIA Security+
GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC)
Relevant AI Security, Cloud Security, Application Security, or Governance certifications are highly desirable.

Physical Requirements

Remains in a sitting/stationary position continually or almost continually during the work day
Operates a computer and performs desk-based computer tasks continually; frequently viewing a computer screen
Rarely lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling objects and/or equipment that weighs up to 50 pounds

NOTE:
This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications.

position, please submit your resume and cover letter to careers@cogentco.com .

jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The TikTok Privacy & Responsibility Product division's goal is to meet all of our privacy, responsibility, and compliance requirements, while providing the best user experience to responsibly consume, create, and enjoy content on TikTok. We focus on building infrastructure and user-facing tools that uphold data transparency, empower user control, and earn trust at scale. As part of this team, you'll help shape the future of privacy on one of the world's most influential platforms, balancing regulatory demands with innovation and usability.

Platform Responsibility team builds the systems that keep our community safe.

You are responsible for developing product safety narratives (internal and external), in close step with XFNs, to demonstrate our responsibility. Your primary role is not that of an external spokesperson or a policy writer.

You will deeply understand product strategies and concepts, write the canonical narratives, coach the wider product org, and act as the trusted single point of contact.

What You Will Own
- Build the Communication Tiering Mechanism
- Tier 1 — Proactive Trust Baseline. Run a recurring cadence of product methodology and roadmap updates to PR / GR / Legal, building mutual fluency before crises hit.
- Tier 2 — Major Launch Alignment. For every significant safety product launch, drive cross-functional pre-launch alignment: define risks, set communication prerequisites (Help Center articles, FAQs), ensure we ship with our story already told.
- Tier 3 — Thematic Deep-Dives. Identify recurring high-stakes topics (e.g., minor safety, predatory behavior governance, machine-moderation logic) and produce canonical internal references.

- Shape Narrative, Not Just Summarize Facts
- Shift the team from reactive fact-collecting to proactive proposition-setting. Hold a clear point of view on what story we want to tell about safety philosophy, then mine facts to support it.
- Translate complex product mechanics into human-centric, press, and policy audiences.
- Maintain our safety design philosophy as a living document; ensure it is consistently reflected in product decisions and external statements.

- Be the Single Point of Contact in High-Stakes Moments
- Serve as the strategic product-side POC for PR / GR / Legal on required communications.
- Lead product-side contribution to inquiries and crisis response, ensuring responses are strategically aligned, technically accurate, and free of over-promises.
- Enable the Wider Product Org
- Coach PMs on narrative construction and stakeholder communication. Build a self-sustaining culture where product decisions ship with their story already articulated.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s)
- Experience: proven experience in Trust & Safety, Policy Communications, Public Affairs, or Product Marketing within a social media platform. Proven track record of driving cross-functional initiatives (across Product, Comms, GR, Legal) without direct authority.
- Storytelling & Acumen: Demonstrated ability to translate highly technical product logic into persuasive, human-centric narratives. High sensitivity to industry trends, media appetite, and regulatory concerns — knowing instinctively what stories resonate with the public and what risks trigger scrutiny. (Writing samples required).
- Domain Expertise: Depth in at least one safety & compliance vertical (e.g., Minor Safety, Content Integrity, AI Safety) and working fluency with at least one major global safety regulatory regime (e.g., UK OSA / OFCOM, EU DSA, US state-level regimes).
- Language: Fluency in written and spoken Chinese is needed to manage stakeholders in the Chinese market.

Preferred Qualification(s)
- Prior experience operating directly inside a Trust & Safety product org, or serving as a regulator-facing communicator at a large platform company.
- Hands-on experience drafting formal, regulator-facing or media-facing materials.

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​
We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​
​
Diversity & Inclusion​
TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​

Chez STMicroelectronics, nous sommes convaincus que la technologie est un moteur d’innovation et a un impact positif pour les entreprises, les personnes et la société.

En tant qu’acteur mondial des semiconducteurs, nos technologies de pointe et nos composants électroniques sont invisibles mais au cœur du monde d’aujourd’hui.

Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.

Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.

Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation.

Notre technologie commence avec vous.

A propos de vos missions

NOTRE FUTURE COLLABORATION

Nous recherchons un(e) Project Manager & Product Owner expérimenté(e)
pour rejoindre notre équipe centrale Manufacturing Data Science (MDS)
. Vous serez responsable de la définition de la vision, du pilotage et de l’industrialisation de solutions innovantes destinées à nos sites de production dans le monde. Ces solutions s’appuient notamment sur le big data, l’intelligence artificielle, l’analytique avancée et les méthodes statistiques.

Basé(e) sur le site de Crolles, en France
, vous évoluerez au cœur d’un environnement industriel de pointe, stimulant et multiculturel. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes locales, notamment les programmes de digitalisation et les équipes Manufacturing, ainsi qu’avec les fonctions centrales IT, Qualité et Engineering.

Vos principales responsabilités

Piloter la construction des solutions et assurer le suivi opérationnel et technique de leur mise en œuvre.
Animer et accompagner les squads en charge des use cases, en collaboration avec les Business Owners et les équipes IT.
Définir, en tant que Product Owner, une vision à moyen et long terme des solutions relevant de vos domaines de responsabilité.
Coordonner les activités avec les Data Scientists et les équipes Data.
Accompagner les équipes dans la résolution des problèmes et lever les obstacles organisationnels.
Conduire les revues opérationnelles portant notamment sur la planification, la validation du ROI et l’engagement des utilisateurs.
Superviser la livraison, les tests et l’évaluation des solutions, ainsi que la mesure et le reporting des KPI.
Évaluer et arbitrer les changements relatifs aux ressources, aux coûts, aux délais et aux moyens tout au long du cycle de vie des projets.
Présenter l’avancement des activités au responsable MDS et aux principales parties prenantes du Manufacturing, notamment lors des comités de pilotage.
Développer et entretenir des relations de proximité avec les sites de production, les fonctions centrales, les équipes IT, les Data Scientists et les fournisseurs de données.
Garantir l’exécution et l’atteinte des objectifs des initiatives MDS.

Ce que nous offrons

Une opportunité unique de contribuer à la conception et au déploiement de solutions innovantes au service des opérations industrielles et des usages analytiques.
Un environnement collaboratif à l’intersection du data engineering, de la data science, de l’IT et des métiers du Manufacturing.
Un rôle à fort impact, contribuant directement à la performance et à la transformation digitale de nos sites de production.
Une expérience permettant de développer une expertise reconnue dans l’industrialisation et le déploiement à l’échelle de solutions fondées sur l’intelligence artificielle.
Des perspectives d’évolution au sein de STMicroelectronics, en fonction des performances, des aspirations professionnelles et des besoins de l’entreprise.

A propos de vous

Diplôme de niveau master en ingénierie, informatique, data science ou dans un domaine connexe.
Plus de cinq ans d’expérience en gestion de projets Data, Analytics, IA ou transformation digitale.
Bonne compréhension des solutions avancées reposant sur la donnée, l’intelligence artificielle, l’analytique et les méthodes statistiques.
Expérience avérée des méthodologies et outils de gestion de projet, notamment des méthodes agiles.
Expérience du rôle de Product Owner, incluant la définition d’une vision produit, la gestion d’une roadmap et la priorisation d’un backlog.
Expérience du management fonctionnel d’équipes pluridisciplinaires et de la coordination transverse.
Capacité à piloter simultanément plusieurs projets complexes dans un environnement international.
Excellentes capacités d’analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décision.
Excellentes compétences en communication, en leadership et en gestion des parties prenantes.
Capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et internationales.
Disponibilité pour effectuer des déplacements sur les sites de production.
Excellente communication écrite et orale en anglais.
Une expérience dans l’industrie des semi-conducteurs ou dans un environnement industriel complexe constitue un atout.

Si vous êtes une personne motivée, proactive, results-driven, avec une passion pour les solutions avancées, la data science, le Manufacturing, que vous êtes à l'aise pour travailler dans un environnement multiculturel, nous vous encourageons à postuler pour cette opportunité passionnante.

ST est fière d’être certifiée parmi les 17 entreprises mondiales « Global Top Employers 2025 » et d’être la première et unique entreprise de semi-conducteurs à recevoir cette distinction. ST a été distinguée dans ce classement grâce à sa démarche d’amélioration continue, se démarquant notamment par son engagement en matière d’éthique et d’intégrité, de sens et de valeurs, d’organisation et de gestion du changement, ainsi que par sa stratégie commerciale et ses performances. En France, ST a également obtenu la labélisation Happy Trainee 2025.

Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié, où la discrimination n’a pas sa place. Notre ambition est de recruter et de fidéliser des talents reflétant la richesse des sociétés dans lesquelles nous évoluons.

Nous nous engageons à l’équité dans le développement des carrières, les opportunités professionnelles et la rémunération.

Chez ST, nous encourageons les candidats qui ne remplissent pas forcément tous les critères à postuler, car nous croyons en la richesse des parcours variés et offrons de réelles opportunités d’apprentissage et d’évolution. Job Summary

The Program Manager, Program Management - SAP S/4HANA Business Transformation, supports a multi-year, enterprise SAP S/4HANA business transformation by coordinating a portfolio of initiatives across Business Owners, SAP/IT teams, and third-party partners. This role focuses on end-to-end Operations (Manufacturing, Maintenance Engineering, Warehouse & Transportation Mgmt) capabilities.

Operating within the Program Management Office (PMO), this role ensures initiatives are aligned to business priorities, governed consistently, integrated across workstreams, and supported by strong business readiness and adoption planning.

This role acts as a connector between strategy and execution, providing portfolio-level visibility, dependency management, and readiness coordination—without owning wave-level deployment delivery.

Essential Duties

Portfolio Planning & Governance

Maintain the transformation portfolio plan, spanning Business readiness projects and SAP activities including initiative sequencing, dependencies, milestones, and key risks with specific focus on Operations (Manufacturing, Maintenance Engineering, Warehouse & Transportation Mgmt) and cross-process dependencies.

Support intake, prioritization, and scope governance aligned to transformation strategy and value drivers.

Ensure initiatives comply with defined governance, stage gates, and decision frameworks.

Prepare executive-ready materials for Steering Committees and portfolio reviews.

Business Owner & Process Owner Engagement

Partner with Business Owners and Enterprise Process Owners to clarify objectives, scope, success measures, and decision ownership across Supply Chain business processes.

Build EPO and business participation plans with EPO’s, Deployment, Change and Training Lead. Track business participation commitments and identify capacity or engagement risks.

Support cross-functional alignment when priorities or dependencies conflict.

SAP / IT Coordination

Work closely with SAP, Data and IT teams to align business priorities with technical delivery plans and release sequencing.

Provide visibility into SAP delivery progress, risks, and dependencies impacting business readiness.

Ensure integration across process, data, reporting, and technology considerations at the portfolio level

Third-Party / System Integrator Coordination

Coordinate with System Integrators and third-party partners to ensure alignment to Supply Chain portfolio priorities and program governance standards.

Track high-level partner deliverables, dependencies, and risks.

Support issue escalation and reinforce expectations for quality, documentation, and knowledge transfer.

Business Readiness & Adoption Support

Coordinate enterprise-level business readiness activities, including readiness baselining, planning, milestone tracking, and participation in design, testing, and training.

Partner with Data, Change, Training, and Communications leads to align readiness activities across initiatives.

Identify and escalate readiness risks related to timing, capacity, or adoption.

Risk, Dependency & Value Tracking

Maintain a portfolio-level view of risks, issues, and cross-initiative dependencies.

Support tracking of business benefits, KPIs, and value realization.

Shift reporting from task completion to business capability and outcome visibility.

Key Interfaces

Business Owners; Process Owners; SAP / IT Teams; Deployment Directors; Data, Change, Training Leads; System Integrators; Transformation Program Director

Under This Roof, We Require

Bachelor’s degree required

8+ years of project/program management experience, including 3–5 years supporting SAP ERP (ECC or S/4HANA) transformations with a focus on Operations

Experience working with business leaders, IT teams, and system integrators

Strong understanding of end-to-end business processes

Ability to manage cross-functional dependencies and readiness risks

Direct experience supporting Operations business processes in an SAP environment.

Under This Roof, We Also Value

The successful candidate will be a high-impact leader who embodies the following attributes:

Integrator and orchestrator: Connects strategy to execution across functions, SAP and third parties.

Proactively risk-focused: Anticipates dependencies and readiness issues before they become delivery problems.

Business-first operator: Prioritizes adaptations, readiness, and outcomes over task completion.

Influence without authority: Drives alignment and progress through collaboration, clarity, and credibility.

Steward of program integrity: Takes ownership of accuracy, consistency, and discipline in reporting, tracking, and governance artifacts to ensure leaders are working from a single, trusted source of truth.

Provide construction management oversight during all phases of the project

Work is performed in both an office and field (construction) environment. Field work requires climbing, walking and standing at a construction site and may be outside in heat/cold, wet/humid, and dry/arid conditions. Some lifting (up to 50 lbs) may be required.

jobs.description:
Type:
Full Time, On-Site

Overtime Exempt:
Exempt

ARMADA HQ

N/A

CONTINGENT UPON AWARD***************

Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior Level Training Program Manager shall:

The Senior Level Training Program Manager shall assist the Government in the execution of all training coordination functions required for the successful student completion of their full training pipeline.
Coordinate with external military human resource command and representatives, internal service elements, and Office of Human Resources (OHR) to validate requisitions and develop requisite JMAS student training schedules.
The Senior Level Training Program Manager shall develop student class rosters for each JMAS iteration. Secure qualifications and perform duties as Unit Security Officer.
Verify student security clearance information and spouse interim access designations through current database of record. Perform duties as Organizational Defense Travel Administrator (ODTA) and Non-DTS Entry Agent (NDEA) in Defense Travel System (DTS) for student travel.
Comply with applicable laws and directives to ensure successful completion of JMAS pipeline training program by all students.
The Senior Level Training Program Manager shall maintain knowledge of Microsoft Office applications and other software programs for various work-related needs.
As needed with approval from the CMDT/VCMDT provide off-site faculty support for approximately ten (10) days three (3) times per year in support of a JMAS exercise in Florida or, under extraordinary circumstances, an alternate venue as deemed necessary by the Commandant.
The Senior Level Training Program Manager shall actively support ongoing JMAS accreditation activities through participation on assigned accreditation committees and/or working groups and attendance at JMAS curriculum reviews; understand and support accreditation efforts by Council on Occupational Education (COE), International Association of Continuing Education and Training (IACET), and potentially others deemed critical by the JMAS Board of Governors.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities (KSAs)

Knowledge of military training program management and student pipeline coordination, including scheduling, roster development, and administrative oversight to ensure successful completion of training programs.
Knowledge of DoD administrative processes and personnel coordination, including working with military human resource commands, internal service elements, and human resources offices to validate training requisitions and manage student assignments.
Ability to coordinate and manage complex training schedules, ensuring alignment of course availability, instructor resources, and student requirements within structured training pipelines.
Knowledge of security administration procedures, including verification of security clearances, handling sensitive information, and performing duties associated with a Unit Security Officer.
Skill in utilizing the Defense Travel System (DTS) and performing duties as an Organizational Defense Travel Administrator (ODTA) and Non-DTS Entry Agent (NDEA) to coordinate and manage official travel for students.
Ability to maintain accurate training records and documentation, including class rosters, clearance verification, travel records, and other program administrative requirements.
Knowledge of accreditation processes and academic program compliance, including support for accreditation bodies such as the Council on Occupational Education (COE) and the International Association of Continuing Education and Training (IACET).
Proficiency in Microsoft Office and related business software, with the ability to prepare reports, track training metrics, maintain databases, and support program management functions.

Minimum/General Experience

The Senior Level Training Program Manager shall have a minimum ten (10) years' experience in business administration, personnel management or intelligence, or
Five (5) years' experience with Bachelor's degree,
Experience desired in a Military Training Environment.

Minimum Education

HS Diploma, or equivalent
Bachelor's degree in an associated discipline is preferred.

jobs.description:
Program Manager/Training LeadEmployment Type: Full TimeDepartment: Project Management

Here at CGS, we are seeking a Program Manger/Training Lead to assist with the design, development, and delivery of training for internal and external audiences for a government client.

CGS brings motivated, highly skilled, and creative people together to solve the government’s most dynamic problems with cutting-edge technology. To carry out our mission, we are seeking candidates who are excited to contribute to government innovation, appreciate collaboration, and can anticipate the needs of others. Here at CGS, we offer an environment in which our employees feel supported, and we encourage professional growth through various learning opportunities.

Skills and attributes for success:- Review draft Training Plans and collaborate with the transformation readiness team to finalize. -Design, develop, and deliver substantive and role-based training as defined in the VCF Transformation Training Plan, and summarized above. The system integrator will provide test scenarios and myVCF system screenshots to inform the training materials.- Design, develop, and co-deliver VCF Substantive training for VCF staff on end-to-end claims lifecycle processes. Substantive training includes curriculum and standardized materials related to policies and procedures for claim review, claim administration, quality control, and payment. The content for these training modules will be provided by VCF subject matter experts. These same experts will co-deliver the training with the support of this vendor training team. This training, which will be delivered as instructor led, in-person, and virtually, will be delivered to approximately 10-75 VCF staff members, depending on the subject matter of the training.- Design and create user-friendly, professional quality graphics and communication media for How-To Guides, website content, and other communications vehicles necessary to inform and educate the public, law firms, and VCF staff about VCF Transformation and the related process and system changes.- In partnership with the VCF team and the system integrator, provide support to staff to ease the transition and ensure a successful rollout of the transformed claim review and operational processes. The selected vendor will work with the VCF Transformation Readiness Team to determine the overall training schedule and timeline- Design and develop myVCF system training using training materials delivered by the myVCF System Integrator.- Design and develop communication materials for internal and external audiences. Support the design and development of internal and external communications as directed by the VCF. This includes development of PowerPoints, handouts, and supporting the planning and execution of focus groups.- Submit for approval by VCF all communications and training materials and track the materials through the approval process to ensure that they are appropriately prioritized, and any necessary adjustments are made.

Qualifications: - Ability to design and develop comprehensive training approach, curriculum, and materials, including manuals, tutorials, and e-learning modules- Minimum of 5 years’ experience developing training for clients - Strong leadership skills to manage and guide the training team, coordinate overall schedule and activities with the VCF Transformation Readiness Team Lead, and communicate updates to VCF leadership- Ability to manage multiple concurrent training workstreams, ensuring quality, on-time deliverables- Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field required- Minimum of 7 years’ experience managing training and communications teams and schedules to achieve successful outcomes- Experience with Salesforce preferred- Must have experience using Adobe Captivate for training development- Ability to obtain a Public Trust clearance.- Must be a United States citizen.

We are committed to solving the most challenging and dynamic problems.

For the past seven years, we’ve been growing our government contracting portfolio, and along the way, we’ve created valuable partnerships by demonstrating a commitment to honesty, professionalism, and quality work.Here at CGS we value honesty through hard work and self-awareness, professionalism in all we do, and to deliver the best quality to our consumers mending those relations for years to come.

We care about our employees. Therefore, we offer a comprehensive benefits package.
- Health, Dental, and Vision- Life Insurance- 401k- Flexible Spending Account (Health, Dependent Care, and Commuter)- Paid Time Off and Observance of State/Federal Holidays

jobs.title: HH-60W Security Manager
jobs.description:
HH-60 W Facility Security Manager - Rotary

Administration of plans and programs for the Andrews Rotary Division in accordance with contract requirements and staff responsibilities. To track property, facilities, assets and inventory in accordance with established plans and programs as required by contract requirements.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Responsible for all aspects of the ARD property control plan including division training requirements.
Performs as the primary control officer for division and government assets.
Ensures division personnel are trained, assets recorded, properly tracked and inventoried in accordance with company policies and United States Air Force directives.
Coordinated Report of Survey actions, assigns control numbers, provides briefings on ROS program as required.
Performs Disaster Control Group (DCG) duties as required. Acts as the primary DCG member representing the 89th MXG and Amentum. Will carry a company phone and respond within ½ hour to designated location as required.
Performs duties as the UCC as required.
Coordinates Logistics Control Center contingency or mobility requirements for equipment and personnel between wing and squadron agencies.
Identifies requirements for new and/or additional facilities and/or repair to existing facilities by preparation and submission of AF Form 332 to Base Civil Engineering (BCE) (3.1.18.1).
Report facility discrepancies IAW Andrews AFB Facilities Manager Handbook (3.1.18.3).
Identify facility upgrade, repair, and improvement requirements and participate in the Andrews AFB Appearance Program (3.1.18.5).
Review Facility status and assess improvements that would enhance the working environment and moral (3.1.18.5).
Responsible for granting facility/restricted area access for Amentum employees.
Verifies security clearance of employees and issues contractor Common Access Cards (CACs) and Restricted Area Badges (RABs) for base and flight line access.
Provides Security Forces Industrial Security Manager with a Visitor Authorization Letter (15.2.12).
Performs all duties and tasks required of the Telephone Control Officer (TCO) IAW AFI 33-111 (3.1.8).
Performs duties and functions in accordance with established company policies, procedures and ISO 9002 requirements.
Perform other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience Required:

A bachelor’s degree preferable.
With a degree, four (4) years’ experience in property control management and plan administration.
Without degree, twelve (12) years of experience.
Knowledge of MS Word and Excel preferred.
Must be able to obtain and maintain a secret security clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain the clearance.

jobs.title: Associate Business Analyst
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Claritas Rx uses AI and predictive modeling to help rare disease and specialty brands remove the barriers that keep patients from accessing and staying on the treatments they need. By uniting the most complete view of the patient journey with purpose-built technologies, we predict and resolve access challenges before they disrupt care, combining advanced analytics, real-world data, AI, and CRM capabilities to increase start and refill rates, reduce abandonment, and improve brand performance. Our mission is to ensure patients with chronic, life-threatening diseases receive the support that enables the greatest benefit from their therapy. Simply put, our promise is progress for every patient journey.

This is the opportunity to help shape a first-in-industry digital health solution alongside a team of mission-driven professionals. We were named one of Inc.'s Best Workplaces in 2025 and recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), and our team genuinely respects and supports each other. We thrive on being fast-paced, innovative, and results-driven, and our employees enjoy a flexible, collaborative work environment, unlimited PTO, stock options, and a growing set of tools and technology to drive innovation for our customers.

The Position

Our Ascend® platform represents the next generation of our delivery capability — a standardized, scalable implementation model that enables faster, higher-quality client onboarding across our specialty pharmacy data ecosystem.

The Associate Business Analyst is a technical executor of the Ascend platform configuration. The top expectation of this role is the ability to lead and manage spec negotiations with data partners — ensuring that inbound and outbound data file specifications are aligned with the Ascend data model before configuration work begins. This requires both deep technical fluency in specialty pharmacy data structures and the communication skills to drive data partners toward compliant, complete specifications without compromising go-live timelines.

Working from the Configuration Blueprint produced by the Delivery Director, the Associate BA owns all data mapping, platform configuration, and internal quality assurance before any client-facing testing begins. The Associate BA operates as a critical resource within the Ascend implementation team — interfacing with Engagement Managers, Delivery Directors, and Customer Engineering — and is expected to communicate capacity constraints proactively given the demands of a multi-client portfolio.

As a member of the Delivery and Operations team, the Associate BA is responsible for executing implementation configuration work, conducting rigorous internal QA, and ensuring that nothing advances to UAT without sign-off. The Associate BA is the standard-vs-custom decision support layer for data: identifying when client requests require escalation to Product or Customer Engineering versus when they can be addressed within the standard data model. This role is primarily remote with occasional travel requirements.

Key Accountabilities

Data Partner Spec Negotiation ★ Primary Accountability

Lead spec negotiations with specialty pharmacy and other data partners to ensure inbound and outbound file specifications are fully aligned with the Ascend data model before configuration begins — this is the single most critical function of the role
Review partner-submitted data specifications for completeness, field-level accuracy, and model alignment; document gaps and drive resolution directly with the data partner
Negotiate field mappings, list-of-values (LOVs), file formats, and delivery cadences with data partners, escalating to the Engagement Manager only when partner alignment cannot be achieved at the working level
Validate test files against finalized specifications and flag discrepancies before data enters the pipeline; maintain a clear record of spec versions and sign-off status across all active partners
Translate data partner constraints into actionable decisions for the implementation team — identifying what can be resolved through configuration, what requires a spec exception, and what must route to Customer Engineering

Platform Configuration & Data Mapping

Own all platform configuration work: data mapping, configuration tooling, business logic implementation, and front-end reporting setup — all driven by the Configuration Blueprint received from the Delivery Director
Review data specifications produced in collaboration with the Engagement Manager; proactively flag data model mismatches or gaps prior to configuration work beginning
Load data into the pipeline using configuration tooling once specifications are finalized and signed off by relevant stakeholders
Collaborate with Customer Engineering on the handoff of data mapping for standard data model onboarding; provide CE with the context needed for custom build workstreams

Internal QA & Quality Standards

Conduct internal QA testing of all configuration work prior to partner or client-facing testing — nothing advances to UAT without BA sign-off
Track and resolve defects identified during internal QA and UAT for all configuration-related issues
Perform quality control procedures to assure configurations and data quality meet acceptance criteria prior to go-live
Develop and maintain QA documentation, test case frameworks, and checklists that support repeatable, auditable testing across implementations

Escalation & Non-Standard Request Routing

Identify whether client requests fall within the standard Ascend data model, require configuration adjustment, or require escalation — to Product for roadmap consideration or to Customer Engineering for custom build
Document and route non-standard requests with clear business need descriptions and technical context so that Product and CE can act without re-scoping
Conduct change impact analysis to assess how updates or non-standard requests may affect system performance and configuration decisions

Cross-Functional Coordination

Consult with Engagement Managers on data partner specs, testing timelines, and UAT scheduling to ensure internal readiness gates are met
Coordinate with Delivery Director on receipt and interpretation of the Configuration Blueprint — the primary work input for each implementation
Report blockers, capacity constraints, and escalations to the Engagement Manager proactively; given a typical 1-BA-to-many implementations ratio, early communication of bandwidth risks is a core accountability
Support the Delivery Director and Customer Success with UAT business validation for configuration-related questions

Process, Documentation & Knowledge Management

Facilitate schema normalization of system databases; maintain data dictionaries and file inventories across customer applications
Consults with cross-functional teams to document business requirements, operating procedures, issue resolution processes, and platform configurations that enable efficient implementation
Develop and maintain an operating playbook that details best practices for configuration sequencing, data partner onboarding, and documentation requirements
Write clear, detailed procedures for internal training and be able to train other Business Analysts as the team scales
Support creation and ongoing maintenance of standard UAT test script templates for core Ascend use cases in partnership with the Delivery Director

Who You Are

Skills & Knowledge:

Ability to lead data partner spec negotiations — driving alignment on file specifications, field mappings, and LOVs across multiple external partners simultaneously
Excellent written and oral communication — able to document complex data relationships clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences
Ability to prioritize, organize, and execute multiple tasks simultaneously with rigorous attention to detail across a high-volume implementation portfolio
A creative approach to operational problem solving and a relentless passion for quality
Knowledge of data management in specialty biotech and/or operations in reimbursement call centers or specialty pharmacies
Familiarity with healthcare data sources — transactional, clinical, and behavioral — including specialty pharmacy data file types (patient demographics, dispense, status, inventory)
Understanding of standard implementation lifecycle frameworks: UAT facilitation, defect triage, QA gating, and go-live readiness
Ability to exercise judgment within broadly defined practices and policies when selecting methods and techniques for configuration decisions

Required

Education & Experience

Bachelor's degree from a 4-year university, Master's degree preferred
Relevant experience in an operations role at a biopharmaceutical manufacturer, reimbursement call center, specialty pharmacy, or data management company
Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other analytic tools — specifically data comparison, conditional formulas, data summary, and conversion
Functional knowledge of Microsoft Office suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
Background and experience with the Business Analysis toolkit including systems development lifecycles, problem solving and root cause analysis methods, and the ability to document business process models
Demonstrated ability to manage deliverables across multiple concurrent implementations or client programs

Preferred

Experience with specialty pharmacy data file specifications, SFTP workflows, and data onboarding processes
Academic training in public health, business administration, and/or operations research
Case management experience in a reimbursement call center or specialty pharmacy
Familiarity with project management tools such as Smartsheet, JIRA, or Confluence
Familiarity with Google Docs, workflow diagram tools, web-based software systems, and relational databases
Experience working within a structured RACI model or implementation team framework

Join Us

We are seeking to add new expertise and perspective to our strong team of experienced professionals. We aspire to a culture of accelerated professional development through: shared learning and collaboration; a respectful and fun work environment; and employee empowerment through the effective use of technology and tools.

We are a highly collaborative team and prioritize opportunities to connect in person. For employees within a reasonable driving distance of each other, we host regional town hall gatherings approximately every other month. These sessions give our teams a chance to come together, share updates, and strengthen relationships beyond day-to-day work.

In addition to our great environment, we offer a competitive salary of $60,000 to $70,000
and benefits package and the opportunity to make a significant impact on a first-in-industry digital health solution. Please send a cover letter along with your resume when applying to the position of interest. Claritas Rx embraces diversity, equality, and transparency. We are committed to building a team that comprises a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and talents. We believe the more inclusive we are, the better we are.

Join us and discover what it feels like to be part of an environment that rewards ingenuity, risk taking and smart work. It's time to fall in love with what you do!

At Claritas Rx, protecting our candidates is a top priority. If you're applying for a role with us, please note:

All legitimate opportunities are posted first on ClaritasRx.com. Check there before trusting external listings.
We believe in meaningful interviews: offers never come after just one phone call or form. Expect multiple video calls to get to know you.
We never ask for fees or payments of any kind during the hiring process.
Our People Operations Team will handle your onboarding, and all equipment comes directly from us—no purchases required.

About

Sekoia.io repense la cybersécurité pour la rendre encore plus

pertinente ,

efficace

et

accessible . L'un des principaux défis que nous relevons est d'analyser et de comprendre en permanence les

menaces émergentes

afin de définir des stratégies appropriées et d'avoir la capacité de les exécuter à grande échelle. En combinant la

technologie

et une

équipe pluridisciplinaire

de passionnés de Threat Intelligence, Sekoia.io a un

fort impact sur la cybersécurité

avec une approche qui

brise les silos , qu'ils soient technologiques, organisationnels ou culturels.

Job Description

Sekoia

is an AI-native SOC platform combining next-generation SIEM, SOAR, and Cyber Threat Intelligence. Following a €26M Series B in 2025, we are scaling the company and preparing for the next stages of our development.

As

Finance Data Analyst , you will turn fragmented financial and corporate data into reliable information for decision-making. Reporting to the

Head of Finance

and working closely with

Data Engineering , you will act as the bridge between Finance and technical teams.

You will

map data sources , clarify definitions, investigate discrepancies, and structure the datasets and reporting needed for financial and corporate steering. You will work hands‑on with the available data without owning the data lake or every integration end‑to‑end. Your role will be to

challenge data quality and assumptions , document what is missing, and

help Finance and leadership rely on consistent and actionable information.

In this evolving environment, you will bring structure while keeping a practical focus on delivering useful analysis, reporting, and automation.

Systems In Scope

Your scope will cover data from the main systems used for financial, commercial, operational, and corporate steering:

Data: Metabase (you will be the owner of the tool)

Finance and planning: Pennylane, Agicap, Pigment (you will be the owner of the data in the tool), and Excel

Revenue and CRM: HubSpot and Younium

People and expenses: Lucca, SILAE, Navan, and TeamTailor (ATS - recruitment tool)

Cloud and infrastructure: AWS, Azure, and OVH billing data

You will work with Data Engineering and the relevant system owners to connect, transform, document, reconcile, and improve the accessibility of this data.

Your Missions

Map and structure Finance data

Map the systems, data sources, owners, definitions, and flows used for financial and corporate steering.

Identify gaps, inconsistencies, duplications, and reconciliation issues between sources.

Define the data requirements for monthly closing, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting.

Clarify the definitions and calculation rules for key metrics such as revenue, ARR, NRR, headcount, payroll cost, COGS, cash, and spend.

Maintain a prioritised backlog of data needs and improvement opportunities with Finance and Data Engineering.

Turn data into reliable analysis

Explore and model data from the data lake and connected business systems.

Build consistent, documented, and reusable Finance and corporate datasets.

Reconcile data across accounting, billing, RevOps, HR, payroll, cash management, and spend‑management systems.

Produce recurring analyses and reporting to support Finance and leadership decision‑making.

Build dashboards and self‑service views when the underlying data is sufficiently reliable.

Support budget‑versus-actuals analysis, variance analysis, cash monitoring, headcount planning, and SaaS metrics analysis.

Improve data quality and automate reporting

Work with Data Engineering and system owners to complete missing data sources, transformations, and quality checks.

Automate recurring analyses, reconciliations, and reporting where this creates clear value.

Contribute to data quality monitoring, documentation, and governance for Finance‑related data.

Document data lineage, metric definitions, business rules, and known limitations.

Prepare reliable datasets for forecasting, anomaly detection, and future AI use cases.

Handle HR, payroll, and other sensitive data with a high level of confidentiality and rigour.

The position is ideally based in Paris, but can also be based in Rennes, or fully remote from Europe. Professional trips paid for by the company might be required.

Your Profile

You have a minimum of 3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, Finance analytics, FP&A analytics, or a related role.

You have strong analytical skills and are able to investigate data across several systems to identify the reasons behind discrepancies.

You have a good command of SQL and experience with at least one BI or data‑visualisation tool.

You are able to translate business questions into clear data requirements, metrics, and analyses.

You understand Finance concepts such as budgeting, forecasting, monthly closing, variance analysis, revenue, cash, costs, and unit economics.

You have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including the ability to audit and structure existing models.

You are professionally fluent in English, both written and spoken.

You have excellent documentation and communication skills, and are able to work effectively with both Finance and technical teams.

You are curious about how the business works, rigorous about data quality, and comfortable making definitions and assumptions explicit.

You are able to work autonomously, prioritise pragmatically, and bring structure to an evolving environment.

Nice-to-have

You have experience in a B2B SaaS, software, or scale-up environment.

You are familiar with SaaS revenue metrics such as MRR, ARR, NRR, churn, and bookings.

You are familiar with SaaS cost metrics, including Storage, Compute, and Retention hosting costs, AI costs, and gross margin.

You have experience working with accounting, billing, HRIS, payroll, CRM, spend‑management, or planning tools.

You understand data warehouses, data modelling, ETL concepts, APIs, or data‑quality frameworks.

You have experience with Python or another language used for analysis and automation.

You have been exposed to HR or payroll data and understand its confidentiality requirements.

Recruitment Process

HR Interview with Clémentine, Talent Acquisition Manager (30')

N+1 Interview with Elie, Head of Finance (60')

Use case to prepare at home

Restitution of the use case with a Data team member (30')

N+2 Interview with Thérèse, CFO (60')

Our process usually takes about 3 weeks, depending on availability; it includes reference calls.

These discussions will help you understand how Sekoia works and what it stands for. But they are also (and above all) an opportunity for you to tell us about your career path and your expectations for your next job!

Sekoia is an equal opportunity employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation. We are committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Possible full remote
