new_jobs.description:
Job Summary

This hybrid day shift role for a Cyber Security Analyst focuses on assessing and managing technology risk across enterprise systems while supporting business operations. The analyst will apply deep risk management experience to safeguard critical assets strengthen control environments and reduce exposure to evolving cyber threats. Experience in check processing domains is beneficial for understanding financial transaction risks and ensuring secure compliant operations.

Responsibilities

Assess enterprise technology environments to identify cyber risks and control gaps applying risk management practices to prioritize remediation efforts that protect critical systems and data.
Develop and maintain comprehensive risk registers that clearly document vulnerabilities threat scenarios impact ratings and mitigation plans to support transparent risk decisions by stakeholders.
Conduct detailed risk assessments for new and existing applications infrastructure changes and third party services to ensure cyber risk is evaluated before deployment or integration.
Collaborate with security engineering and operations teams to define practical risk reduction actions translate findings into clear requirements and ensure mitigation steps align with business needs.
Monitor security alerts risk indicators and incident trends to detect emerging risk patterns and provide timely recommendations that strengthen defenses and reduce recurrence.
Coordinate periodic control testing and validation activities to verify that implemented risk treatments are effective measurable and aligned with internal standards and regulatory obligations.
Prepare concise risk reports and dashboards for management that highlight key risk drivers residual exposure levels and the progress of remediation initiatives across technology domains.
Support policy and standard development by providing input based on observed risks and incidents ensuring that documented expectations are practical and aligned with recognized security frameworks.
Advise project teams during system design and change initiatives to embed appropriate security controls ensuring risk considerations are addressed early and reducing the need for costly rework.
Engage with business stakeholders to explain cyber risk in clear terms enabling informed decisions that balance protective measures with operational efficiency and customer impact.
Apply knowledge of payment and transaction flows especially in check processing environments to identify fraud and operational risks and propose control enhancements that secure financial operations.
Contribute to continuous improvement by documenting lessons learned from assessments and near miss events recommending updates to risk methodologies tools and processes for better outcomes.
Maintain accurate and current documentation of risk management activities methodologies and outcomes to support audits compliance reviews and organizational learning.

Qualifications

Demonstrate five to seven years of professional experience in cyber security roles focused on risk management including practical exposure to risk assessment mitigation planning and control evaluation.
Possess strong knowledge of core risk management concepts such as likelihood analysis impact determination control effectiveness and residual risk calculation within technology environments.
Apply familiarity with industry security frameworks and standards using them as references for designing and assessing controls across applications networks and data handling processes.
Exhibit analytical skills to interpret complex technical information security alerts and vulnerability data translating them into understandable risk statements and prioritized actions.
Utilize excellent communication abilities to prepare clear documentation risk reports and stakeholder updates that support decision making and foster shared understanding of cyber exposures.
Bring working knowledge of financial or payment processing domains including check processing to enhance understanding of transaction risks and to guide secure process and system design.

new_jobs.description:
Company

Cogent Communications is a global, Tier 1 facilities-based ISP, consistently ranked as one of the top five networks in the world and is publicly traded on the NASDAQ Stock Market under the ticker symbol CCOI. Cogent specializes in providing businesses with high speed Internet access and Ethernet transport services. Cogent's facilities-based, all-optical IP network backbone provides IP services globally. Since its inception, Cogent has unleashed the benefits of IP technology, building one of the largest and highest capacity IP networks in the world. This network enables Cogent to offer large bandwidth connections at highly competitive prices. Cogent also offers superior customer support by virtue of its end-to-end control of service delivery and network monitoring. A competitive base salary and a full benefits package including; Health, Dental, Vision, Paid Time Off (PTO), Short and Long Term Disability, Life Insurance, Holidays, Parental Leave, 401(k) plan with employer match, stock options, and an Employee Assistance Program. Most benefits take effect within 30 days of employment, and some require a waiting period.

Job Summary

The Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance)
is responsible for protecting the organization's information assets, technology infrastructure, applications, cloud environments, data, and artificial intelligence (AI) initiatives from cyber threats and misuse. This role serves as a key contributor to both cybersecurity operations and AI governance programs by identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating risks associated with Information Systems as well as AI-enabled technologies.

The Cybersecurity Analyst (Security & AI Governance) works closely with IT teams, software developers, business stakeholders, and external partners to ensure cybersecurity and AI initiatives align with security policies, industry standards, regulatory requirements, and emerging AI governance frameworks. This position will work closely with the CIO/CISO functions to provide a cohesive plan for cybersecurity initiatives, AI governance, Shadow AI oversight, risk management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Compensation

[Starting / Initial] Base Salary Pay Range: $110,000 - $130,000

Specific offers within the listed pay ranges are determined by a variety of factors such as experience, education, skills, certifications and business needs.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Monitor security systems, networks, applications, cloud platforms, and AI-enabled services for suspicious activity and potential threats.
Perform security assessments and risk analyses of systems, applications, AI solutions, and business processes.
Assist in the development, implementation, and continuous improvements of cybersecurity and AI governance policies, standards, procedures, and controls.
Collaborate with IT, software development, and business teams to implement security best practices and controls (security-by-design principles and secure technology solutions)
Participate in the review, risk assessment, and governance oversight of internally developed AI solutions, machine learning models, and employee-driven AI initiatives.
Evaluate third-party AI vendors, applications, and services for cybersecurity, privacy, compliance, data protection, and operational risks.
Identify, assess, and monitor risks associated with generative AI, large language models (LLMs), machine learning platforms, prompt injection attacks, data leakage, insecure APIs, and AI supply chain vulnerabilities.
Assist with the development and administration of the organization's AI governance and Shadow AI oversight programs.
Support secure development practices for internally developed applications and AI-enabled solutions, and emerging technology initiatives.
Participate in security awareness and AI awareness training initiatives for employees.
Assist with audits, compliance reviews, AI governance assessments, and regulatory reporting requirements.
Research emerging cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, cybersecurity trends, AI technologies, and industry best practices and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies/countermeasures.
Maintain inventories of approved AI solutions, AI vendors, and AI-related business initiatives.
Develop and maintain reports, dashboards, metrics, risk assessments, and documentation related to cybersecurity operations, AI governance, compliance and enterprise risk management activities.

Qualifications

Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Risk Management, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant professional experience.
Minimum of 2–5 years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, GRC, application security, vendor risk, privacy, IT audit, compliance, technology governance, or a related discipline.
Experience performing technology, security, vendor, application, privacy, or operational risk assessments.
Experience developing, interpreting, implementing, or supporting technology policies, standards, procedures, or governance processes.
Experience evaluating new technologies, applications, vendors, or services from a risk and security perspective.
Experience working collaboratively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to document risks and develop recommendations for both technical and executive audiences.
Demonstrated interest in artificial intelligence, generative AI, responsible AI adoption, and emerging technology risk.
Familiarity with generative AI, machine learning concepts, large language models (LLMs), or AI-enabled business applications.

Proficient In The Following Areas

Familiarity with AI governance principles and emerging AI risk management frameworks.
AI governance concepts and risks associated with generative AI technologies.
Data protection, data classification, privacy, and appropriate data use.
Knowledge of application security concepts, API security, and secure software development practices.
Understanding of risks associated with generative AI platforms, LLMs, prompt injection, data privacy, and AI model security.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to independently research emerging technologies and translate findings into practical recommendations.
Ability to write and present formal documentation, risk assessments, and executive-level reports.
Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and standards, including CIS Controls, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and security best practices.
Experience with security information and event management (SIEM) tools and security monitoring platforms is a PLUS.
Experience supporting software development, DevSecOps, or application security initiatives is a PLUS.

Preferred Certifications

Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
Certified in Risk and Information Systems Control (CRISC)
CompTIA Security+
GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC)
Relevant AI Security, Cloud Security, Application Security, or Governance certifications are highly desirable.

Physical Requirements

Remains in a sitting/stationary position continually or almost continually during the work day
Operates a computer and performs desk-based computer tasks continually; frequently viewing a computer screen
Rarely lifting, carrying, pushing, pulling objects and/or equipment that weighs up to 50 pounds

NOTE:
This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications.

position, please submit your resume and cover letter to careers@cogentco.com .

new_jobs.title: Safety Program Manager (Trust Building), TikTok Platform Responsibility
new_jobs.description:
Responsibilities

The TikTok Privacy & Responsibility Product division's goal is to meet all of our privacy, responsibility, and compliance requirements, while providing the best user experience to responsibly consume, create, and enjoy content on TikTok. We focus on building infrastructure and user-facing tools that uphold data transparency, empower user control, and earn trust at scale. As part of this team, you'll help shape the future of privacy on one of the world's most influential platforms, balancing regulatory demands with innovation and usability.

Platform Responsibility team builds the systems that keep our community safe.

You are responsible for developing product safety narratives (internal and external), in close step with XFNs, to demonstrate our responsibility. Your primary role is not that of an external spokesperson or a policy writer.

You will deeply understand product strategies and concepts, write the canonical narratives, coach the wider product org, and act as the trusted single point of contact.

What You Will Own
- Build the Communication Tiering Mechanism
- Tier 1 — Proactive Trust Baseline. Run a recurring cadence of product methodology and roadmap updates to PR / GR / Legal, building mutual fluency before crises hit.
- Tier 2 — Major Launch Alignment. For every significant safety product launch, drive cross-functional pre-launch alignment: define risks, set communication prerequisites (Help Center articles, FAQs), ensure we ship with our story already told.
- Tier 3 — Thematic Deep-Dives. Identify recurring high-stakes topics (e.g., minor safety, predatory behavior governance, machine-moderation logic) and produce canonical internal references.

- Shape Narrative, Not Just Summarize Facts
- Shift the team from reactive fact-collecting to proactive proposition-setting. Hold a clear point of view on what story we want to tell about safety philosophy, then mine facts to support it.
- Translate complex product mechanics into human-centric, press, and policy audiences.
- Maintain our safety design philosophy as a living document; ensure it is consistently reflected in product decisions and external statements.

- Be the Single Point of Contact in High-Stakes Moments
- Serve as the strategic product-side POC for PR / GR / Legal on required communications.
- Lead product-side contribution to inquiries and crisis response, ensuring responses are strategically aligned, technically accurate, and free of over-promises.
- Enable the Wider Product Org
- Coach PMs on narrative construction and stakeholder communication. Build a self-sustaining culture where product decisions ship with their story already articulated.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualification(s)
- Experience: proven experience in Trust & Safety, Policy Communications, Public Affairs, or Product Marketing within a social media platform. Proven track record of driving cross-functional initiatives (across Product, Comms, GR, Legal) without direct authority.
- Storytelling & Acumen: Demonstrated ability to translate highly technical product logic into persuasive, human-centric narratives. High sensitivity to industry trends, media appetite, and regulatory concerns — knowing instinctively what stories resonate with the public and what risks trigger scrutiny. (Writing samples required).
- Domain Expertise: Depth in at least one safety & compliance vertical (e.g., Minor Safety, Content Integrity, AI Safety) and working fluency with at least one major global safety regulatory regime (e.g., UK OSA / OFCOM, EU DSA, US state-level regimes).
- Language: Fluency in written and spoken Chinese is needed to manage stakeholders in the Chinese market.

Rejoindre ST, c’est intégrer une entreprise internationale riche de plus de 115 nationalités, présente dans 40 pays, et rassemblant plus de 50 000 talents passionnés et engagés, tous unis par la volonté de créer et d’inventer la technologie de demain.

Innover demande bien plus que des compétences techniques : cela nécessite des personnes inspirantes, qui savent collaborer avec respect et enthousiasme. Des collaborateurs animés par la passion, prêts à remettre en question le statu quo, à faire avancer l’innovation et à révéler leur plein potentiel.

Venez vivre cette aventure avec nous et contribuez à construire un futur plus intelligent et plus durable, en alliant responsabilité et innovation.

Notre technologie commence avec vous.

A propos de vos missions

NOTRE FUTURE COLLABORATION

Nous recherchons un(e) Project Manager & Product Owner expérimenté(e)
pour rejoindre notre équipe centrale Manufacturing Data Science (MDS)
. Vous serez responsable de la définition de la vision, du pilotage et de l’industrialisation de solutions innovantes destinées à nos sites de production dans le monde. Ces solutions s’appuient notamment sur le big data, l’intelligence artificielle, l’analytique avancée et les méthodes statistiques.

Basé(e) sur le site de Crolles, en France
, vous évoluerez au cœur d’un environnement industriel de pointe, stimulant et multiculturel. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les équipes locales, notamment les programmes de digitalisation et les équipes Manufacturing, ainsi qu’avec les fonctions centrales IT, Qualité et Engineering.

Vos principales responsabilités

Piloter la construction des solutions et assurer le suivi opérationnel et technique de leur mise en œuvre.
Animer et accompagner les squads en charge des use cases, en collaboration avec les Business Owners et les équipes IT.
Définir, en tant que Product Owner, une vision à moyen et long terme des solutions relevant de vos domaines de responsabilité.
Coordonner les activités avec les Data Scientists et les équipes Data.
Accompagner les équipes dans la résolution des problèmes et lever les obstacles organisationnels.
Conduire les revues opérationnelles portant notamment sur la planification, la validation du ROI et l’engagement des utilisateurs.
Superviser la livraison, les tests et l’évaluation des solutions, ainsi que la mesure et le reporting des KPI.
Évaluer et arbitrer les changements relatifs aux ressources, aux coûts, aux délais et aux moyens tout au long du cycle de vie des projets.
Présenter l’avancement des activités au responsable MDS et aux principales parties prenantes du Manufacturing, notamment lors des comités de pilotage.

Ce que nous offrons

Une opportunité unique de contribuer à la conception et au déploiement de solutions innovantes au service des opérations industrielles et des usages analytiques.
Un environnement collaboratif à l’intersection du data engineering, de la data science, de l’IT et des métiers du Manufacturing.
Un rôle à fort impact, contribuant directement à la performance et à la transformation digitale de nos sites de production.
Une expérience permettant de développer une expertise reconnue dans l’industrialisation et le déploiement à l’échelle de solutions fondées sur l’intelligence artificielle.
Des perspectives d’évolution au sein de STMicroelectronics, en fonction des performances, des aspirations professionnelles et des besoins de l’entreprise.

Diplôme de niveau master en ingénierie, informatique, data science ou dans un domaine connexe.
Plus de cinq ans d’expérience en gestion de projets Data, Analytics, IA ou transformation digitale.
Bonne compréhension des solutions avancées reposant sur la donnée, l’intelligence artificielle, l’analytique et les méthodes statistiques.
Expérience avérée des méthodologies et outils de gestion de projet, notamment des méthodes agiles.
Expérience du rôle de Product Owner, incluant la définition d’une vision produit, la gestion d’une roadmap et la priorisation d’un backlog.
Expérience du management fonctionnel d’équipes pluridisciplinaires et de la coordination transverse.
Capacité à piloter simultanément plusieurs projets complexes dans un environnement international.
Excellentes capacités d’analyse, de résolution de problèmes et de prise de décision.
Excellentes compétences en communication, en leadership et en gestion des parties prenantes.
Capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des équipes pluridisciplinaires et internationales.
Disponibilité pour effectuer des déplacements sur les sites de production.
Excellente communication écrite et orale en anglais.
Une expérience dans l’industrie des semi-conducteurs ou dans un environnement industriel complexe constitue un atout.

Si vous êtes une personne motivée, proactive, results-driven, avec une passion pour les solutions avancées, la data science, le Manufacturing, que vous êtes à l'aise pour travailler dans un environnement multiculturel, nous vous encourageons à postuler pour cette opportunité passionnante.

Nous cultivons un environnement de travail inclusif et diversifié, où la discrimination n’a pas sa place. Notre ambition est de recruter et de fidéliser des talents reflétant la richesse des sociétés dans lesquelles nous évoluons.

Nous nous engageons à l’équité dans le développement des carrières, les opportunités professionnelles et la rémunération.

Chez ST, nous encourageons les candidats qui ne remplissent pas forcément tous les critères à postuler, car nous croyons en la richesse des parcours variés et offrons de réelles opportunités d’apprentissage et d’évolution. The Program Manager, Program Management - SAP S/4HANA Business Transformation, supports a multi-year, enterprise SAP S/4HANA business transformation by coordinating a portfolio of initiatives across Business Owners, SAP/IT teams, and third-party partners. This role focuses on end-to-end Operations (Manufacturing, Maintenance Engineering, Warehouse & Transportation Mgmt) capabilities.

Operating within the Program Management Office (PMO), this role ensures initiatives are aligned to business priorities, governed consistently, integrated across workstreams, and supported by strong business readiness and adoption planning.

This role acts as a connector between strategy and execution, providing portfolio-level visibility, dependency management, and readiness coordination—without owning wave-level deployment delivery.

Essential Duties

Portfolio Planning & Governance

Maintain the transformation portfolio plan, spanning Business readiness projects and SAP activities including initiative sequencing, dependencies, milestones, and key risks with specific focus on Operations (Manufacturing, Maintenance Engineering, Warehouse & Transportation Mgmt) and cross-process dependencies.

Support intake, prioritization, and scope governance aligned to transformation strategy and value drivers.

Ensure initiatives comply with defined governance, stage gates, and decision frameworks.

Prepare executive-ready materials for Steering Committees and portfolio reviews.

Business Owner & Process Owner Engagement

Partner with Business Owners and Enterprise Process Owners to clarify objectives, scope, success measures, and decision ownership across Supply Chain business processes.

Build EPO and business participation plans with EPO’s, Deployment, Change and Training Lead. Track business participation commitments and identify capacity or engagement risks.

Support cross-functional alignment when priorities or dependencies conflict.

SAP / IT Coordination

Work closely with SAP, Data and IT teams to align business priorities with technical delivery plans and release sequencing.

Provide visibility into SAP delivery progress, risks, and dependencies impacting business readiness.

Ensure integration across process, data, reporting, and technology considerations at the portfolio level

Third-Party / System Integrator Coordination

Coordinate with System Integrators and third-party partners to ensure alignment to Supply Chain portfolio priorities and program governance standards.

Track high-level partner deliverables, dependencies, and risks.

Support issue escalation and reinforce expectations for quality, documentation, and knowledge transfer.

Business Readiness & Adoption Support

Coordinate enterprise-level business readiness activities, including readiness baselining, planning, milestone tracking, and participation in design, testing, and training.

Partner with Data, Change, Training, and Communications leads to align readiness activities across initiatives.

Identify and escalate readiness risks related to timing, capacity, or adoption.

Risk, Dependency & Value Tracking

Maintain a portfolio-level view of risks, issues, and cross-initiative dependencies.

Support tracking of business benefits, KPIs, and value realization.

Shift reporting from task completion to business capability and outcome visibility.

Key Interfaces

Business Owners; Process Owners; SAP / IT Teams; Deployment Directors; Data, Change, Training Leads; System Integrators; Transformation Program Director

Under This Roof, We Require

Bachelor’s degree required

8+ years of project/program management experience, including 3–5 years supporting SAP ERP (ECC or S/4HANA) transformations with a focus on Operations

Experience working with business leaders, IT teams, and system integrators

Strong understanding of end-to-end business processes

Ability to manage cross-functional dependencies and readiness risks

Direct experience supporting Operations business processes in an SAP environment.

Under This Roof, We Also Value

The successful candidate will be a high-impact leader who embodies the following attributes:

Integrator and orchestrator: Connects strategy to execution across functions, SAP and third parties.

Proactively risk-focused: Anticipates dependencies and readiness issues before they become delivery problems.

Business-first operator: Prioritizes adaptations, readiness, and outcomes over task completion.

Influence without authority: Drives alignment and progress through collaboration, clarity, and credibility.

Steward of program integrity: Takes ownership of accuracy, consistency, and discipline in reporting, tracking, and governance artifacts to ensure leaders are working from a single, trusted source of truth.

new_jobs.title: Associate Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
Who We Are

Claritas Rx uses AI and predictive modeling to help rare disease and specialty brands remove the barriers that keep patients from accessing and staying on the treatments they need. By uniting the most complete view of the patient journey with purpose-built technologies, we predict and resolve access challenges before they disrupt care, combining advanced analytics, real-world data, AI, and CRM capabilities to increase start and refill rates, reduce abandonment, and improve brand performance. Our mission is to ensure patients with chronic, life-threatening diseases receive the support that enables the greatest benefit from their therapy. Simply put, our promise is progress for every patient journey.

This is the opportunity to help shape a first-in-industry digital health solution alongside a team of mission-driven professionals. We were named one of Inc.'s Best Workplaces in 2025 and recognized on the Inc. 5000 list for two consecutive years (2025 and 2026), and our team genuinely respects and supports each other. We thrive on being fast-paced, innovative, and results-driven, and our employees enjoy a flexible, collaborative work environment, unlimited PTO, stock options, and a growing set of tools and technology to drive innovation for our customers.

The Position

Our Ascend® platform represents the next generation of our delivery capability — a standardized, scalable implementation model that enables faster, higher-quality client onboarding across our specialty pharmacy data ecosystem.

The Associate Business Analyst is a technical executor of the Ascend platform configuration. The top expectation of this role is the ability to lead and manage spec negotiations with data partners — ensuring that inbound and outbound data file specifications are aligned with the Ascend data model before configuration work begins. This requires both deep technical fluency in specialty pharmacy data structures and the communication skills to drive data partners toward compliant, complete specifications without compromising go-live timelines.

Working from the Configuration Blueprint produced by the Delivery Director, the Associate BA owns all data mapping, platform configuration, and internal quality assurance before any client-facing testing begins. The Associate BA operates as a critical resource within the Ascend implementation team — interfacing with Engagement Managers, Delivery Directors, and Customer Engineering — and is expected to communicate capacity constraints proactively given the demands of a multi-client portfolio.

As a member of the Delivery and Operations team, the Associate BA is responsible for executing implementation configuration work, conducting rigorous internal QA, and ensuring that nothing advances to UAT without sign-off. The Associate BA is the standard-vs-custom decision support layer for data: identifying when client requests require escalation to Product or Customer Engineering versus when they can be addressed within the standard data model. This role is primarily remote with occasional travel requirements.

Key Accountabilities

Review data specifications produced in collaboration with the Engagement Manager; proactively flag data model mismatches or gaps prior to configuration work beginning

Process, Documentation & Knowledge Management

Consults with cross-functional teams to document business requirements, operating procedures, issue resolution processes, and platform configurations that enable efficient implementation

Support creation and ongoing maintenance of standard UAT test script templates for core Ascend use cases in partnership with the Delivery Director

Who You Are

Skills & Knowledge:

Ability to lead data partner spec negotiations — driving alignment on file specifications, field mappings, and LOVs across multiple external partners simultaneously
Excellent written and oral communication — able to document complex data relationships clearly for both technical and non-technical audiences
Ability to prioritize, organize, and execute multiple tasks simultaneously with rigorous attention to detail across a high-volume implementation portfolio
A creative approach to operational problem solving and a relentless passion for quality
Knowledge of data management in specialty biotech and/or operations in reimbursement call centers or specialty pharmacies
Familiarity with healthcare data sources — transactional, clinical, and behavioral — including specialty pharmacy data file types (patient demographics, dispense, status, inventory)
Understanding of standard implementation lifecycle frameworks: UAT facilitation, defect triage, QA gating, and go-live readiness
Ability to exercise judgment within broadly defined practices and policies when selecting methods and techniques for configuration decisions

Required

Education & Experience

Relevant experience in an operations role at a biopharmaceutical manufacturer, reimbursement call center, specialty pharmacy, or data management company
Proficient in Microsoft Excel and other analytic tools — specifically data comparison, conditional formulas, data summary, and conversion
Functional knowledge of Microsoft Office suite (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
Background and experience with the Business Analysis toolkit including systems development lifecycles, problem solving and root cause analysis methods, and the ability to document business process models

About

Sekoia.io repense la cybersécurité pour la rendre encore plus

pertinente ,

efficace

et

accessible . L'un des principaux défis que nous relevons est d'analyser et de comprendre en permanence les

menaces émergentes

afin de définir des stratégies appropriées et d'avoir la capacité de les exécuter à grande échelle. En combinant la

technologie

et une

équipe pluridisciplinaire

de passionnés de Threat Intelligence, Sekoia.io a un

fort impact sur la cybersécurité

avec une approche qui

brise les silos , qu'ils soient technologiques, organisationnels ou culturels.

Job Description

Sekoia

is an AI-native SOC platform combining next-generation SIEM, SOAR, and Cyber Threat Intelligence. Following a €26M Series B in 2025, we are scaling the company and preparing for the next stages of our development.

As

Finance Data Analyst , you will turn fragmented financial and corporate data into reliable information for decision-making. Reporting to the

Head of Finance

and working closely with

Data Engineering , you will act as the bridge between Finance and technical teams.

You will

map data sources , clarify definitions, investigate discrepancies, and structure the datasets and reporting needed for financial and corporate steering. You will work hands‑on with the available data without owning the data lake or every integration end‑to‑end. Your role will be to

challenge data quality and assumptions , document what is missing, and

help Finance and leadership rely on consistent and actionable information.

In this evolving environment, you will bring structure while keeping a practical focus on delivering useful analysis, reporting, and automation.

Systems In Scope

Your scope will cover data from the main systems used for financial, commercial, operational, and corporate steering:

Data: Metabase (you will be the owner of the tool)

Finance and planning: Pennylane, Agicap, Pigment (you will be the owner of the data in the tool), and Excel

Revenue and CRM: HubSpot and Younium

People and expenses: Lucca, SILAE, Navan, and TeamTailor (ATS - recruitment tool)

Cloud and infrastructure: AWS, Azure, and OVH billing data

You will work with Data Engineering and the relevant system owners to connect, transform, document, reconcile, and improve the accessibility of this data.

Your Missions

Map and structure Finance data

Map the systems, data sources, owners, definitions, and flows used for financial and corporate steering.

Identify gaps, inconsistencies, duplications, and reconciliation issues between sources.

Define the data requirements for monthly closing, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting.

Clarify the definitions and calculation rules for key metrics such as revenue, ARR, NRR, headcount, payroll cost, COGS, cash, and spend.

Maintain a prioritised backlog of data needs and improvement opportunities with Finance and Data Engineering.

Turn data into reliable analysis

Explore and model data from the data lake and connected business systems.

Build consistent, documented, and reusable Finance and corporate datasets.

Reconcile data across accounting, billing, RevOps, HR, payroll, cash management, and spend‑management systems.

Produce recurring analyses and reporting to support Finance and leadership decision‑making.

Build dashboards and self‑service views when the underlying data is sufficiently reliable.

Support budget‑versus-actuals analysis, variance analysis, cash monitoring, headcount planning, and SaaS metrics analysis.

Improve data quality and automate reporting

Work with Data Engineering and system owners to complete missing data sources, transformations, and quality checks.

Automate recurring analyses, reconciliations, and reporting where this creates clear value.

Contribute to data quality monitoring, documentation, and governance for Finance‑related data.

Document data lineage, metric definitions, business rules, and known limitations.

Prepare reliable datasets for forecasting, anomaly detection, and future AI use cases.

Handle HR, payroll, and other sensitive data with a high level of confidentiality and rigour.

The position is ideally based in Paris, but can also be based in Rennes, or fully remote from Europe. Professional trips paid for by the company might be required.

Your Profile

You have a minimum of 3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, Finance analytics, FP&A analytics, or a related role.

You have strong analytical skills and are able to investigate data across several systems to identify the reasons behind discrepancies.

You have a good command of SQL and experience with at least one BI or data‑visualisation tool.

You are able to translate business questions into clear data requirements, metrics, and analyses.

You understand Finance concepts such as budgeting, forecasting, monthly closing, variance analysis, revenue, cash, costs, and unit economics.

You have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including the ability to audit and structure existing models.

You are professionally fluent in English, both written and spoken.

You have excellent documentation and communication skills, and are able to work effectively with both Finance and technical teams.

You are curious about how the business works, rigorous about data quality, and comfortable making definitions and assumptions explicit.

You are able to work autonomously, prioritise pragmatically, and bring structure to an evolving environment.

Nice-to-have

You have experience in a B2B SaaS, software, or scale-up environment.

You are familiar with SaaS revenue metrics such as MRR, ARR, NRR, churn, and bookings.

You are familiar with SaaS cost metrics, including Storage, Compute, and Retention hosting costs, AI costs, and gross margin.

You have experience working with accounting, billing, HRIS, payroll, CRM, spend‑management, or planning tools.

You understand data warehouses, data modelling, ETL concepts, APIs, or data‑quality frameworks.

You have experience with Python or another language used for analysis and automation.

You have been exposed to HR or payroll data and understand its confidentiality requirements.

Recruitment Process

HR Interview with Clémentine, Talent Acquisition Manager (30')

N+1 Interview with Elie, Head of Finance (60')

Use case to prepare at home

Restitution of the use case with a Data team member (30')

N+2 Interview with Thérèse, CFO (60')

Our process usually takes about 3 weeks, depending on availability; it includes reference calls.

These discussions will help you understand how Sekoia works and what it stands for. But they are also (and above all) an opportunity for you to tell us about your career path and your expectations for your next job!

Sekoia is an equal opportunity employer for any minority, disability, gender identity or sexual orientation. We are committed to hiring and supporting diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.

Possible full remote
